40: Reshu leistakkala bettofrin bemotzae shabbat deha naharin mehahu sheragga venaharin mehahu esh leshaltaa.

Illen itchazyayn, etzbean lego la it reshu leitchazyay behahu sheragga deha milleela naharin veikrun panim penimain. veraza da veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau. dela yistakkal bar nash bemotzae shabbat beetzbean lego beshaata deamar bore meore haesh. (shabbat 33) veraita et achoray illen panim dilvar deitremizu betufere. (sham) ufanay lo yerau illen etzbean lego. illen shalte beshabbatta veillen shalte bachol.

Uveyoma deshabbatta kudesha berich hu shallit bilchodoy beinnun panim penimain al kurese (5) yekareh vechulhu itkelilan beh veshaltanuta dileh ihu. uvegin kach achsin nayycha lechol almin. veyartin yeruta deyoma da amma kaddisha deikrun amma chad beara. meore or missitra deyamina deihu or kadmaa dehava beyoma kadmaa. devyoma deshabbatta naharin innun meore or bilchodayyhu veshaltin. uminnayyhu naharin kulhu letatta.

Vechad nafik shabbatta genizin (innun) meore or dela itgalyayn. umeore haesh shaltin kol chad vechad al duchetayyhu. ematay shaltin bemotzae shabbat ad maale yoma deshabbatta. veal da itzterichu leitnahara mehahu sheragga bemotzae shabbat.

Vehachayyot ratzo vashov. dela yachil ena lemishlat behu begin deinnun ratzo vashov. chayyot deitgalleyayn innun dehahu ofan kaim begavvavyyhu, uman ihu da metatron deihu rav veyakkir mishar illen (nusach acher chayyaylin), veillaa chamesh mea parse.

Chayyot demittamran innun (rabeyaan) techot teren atvavn illain deitkasyayn. 15 atvavn shallitin al 11. illen reticha leillen. vehahu temira lechol temirin dela ityedo kelal shallit al kolla verachiv al kolla. chayyot deitgalleyayn innun letatta techot illen illain demittamran, veitnaharan minnayyhu, venatlin beginayyhu.

Chayyot illain kulhu kelilan (Bereshit 33 amud bet) birkia hashshamayim. vealayyhu ketiv yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim vehayu limorot birkia hashshamayim. kulhu talyayn behahu rekia hashshamayim. rakia sheal gabbe hachayyot da hahu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach da hahu kadmon (nusach acher Adonai kadmaa).

Deha mittamman ulehala let man deyachil leistakkala uleminda. may tama mishshum deihu satim bemachashava. umachashava dekudesha berich hu temira setima illaa. machashava devar nash bechol alma (sefer acher lo yachil) leitdabbeka uleminda lah. millin detalyayn bemachashava illaa let man deyachil leitdabbeka lon. machashava (illaa) mammash al achat kamma vekamma. lego min machashava man ihu deavid raayone. deha let sucheltanu lemishal kol shekken leminda.

En sof let beh rishshuma kelal vela talya sheelta beh vela raayona leistakkeluta demachashava kelal. miggo setima distima, merish nechitu deen sof, nehir nehiru dakkik vela yedia. satim bistimu (nusach acher birshimu) kechidduda demachata. raza setima demachashava la yedia ad deitpeshat nehiru minneh. beatar deit beh reshimin deatvavn kulhu. mittamman nafkan.

Beresh kolla. 1 resha vesofa dechol dargin. reshimu deitreshim beh dargin kulhu. vela ikre ella echad. leachazaa deaf al gav deit beh diukenin saggiin lav ihu ela chad. vadday ihu at deillain vetattain talyayn beh.

Reshita dealef temiru deraza demachashava illaa. vehahu itpashtu dehahu rakia illaa kolla satim behahu resha. begin dechad nafik 1 mehay rakia bediyyukena deraza derisha demachashava nafka. behahu emtzaita dealef shit dargin kelilan beh raza dechulhu chayyot temirin illain (sefer acher daselaykan) (sefer acher detalyayn) miggo machashava.

Chad nehiru denahir veitgeniz. deha nehiru deat (9) divreshit (sefer acher 2 divreshit). chom hayyom dehava avraham yativ petach haohel deihi pitcha mittatta leela. vechom hayyom nahir al hahu pitcha venahara mittamman.

Tinyana nehiru deazil leitchashcha leet penot erev. raza ditzlota deyitzchak leatkana hay darga dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot erev. istakkeluta deerev vachashochan kulhu legabbeh. behay penot erev veistakkal nusach acher istechan yaakov behahu memanna deesav.
41: Ilen. nehiru denahir beasvavta. raza dichtiv beyaakov (Bereshit lak) vayyizrach lo hashshemesh vegomer. vadday kad itkelil behahu penot erev. mikkan ulehala vehu tzolea al yerecho. da ihu netzach yisrael.

Al yerecho yerecho ketiv velo yerechav, da darga reviaa. dela (171 1) itnabbe bar nash mittamman ad deata shemuel, vealeh ketiv, (Shmuel 1 15) vegam netzach yisrael vegomer, keden itkan dehava chalsha mikkad istakken yaakov avinu bimmanna deesav.

(Tikkunim 25) vayyigga bechaf yerecho kad ata legabbe deyaakov netal tukefa mehahu penot erev bedina takkifa. veyaakov hava itkelil beh vela yachil leh. vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho. natal tukefa dedina mittamman. begin (146 1, 166 1, 171 1) deyarcha ihu levar miggufa. deyaakov gufa hava, veguppeh hava kalil beraza ditren dargin beraza deikre adam. kevan denatal tukefa levar miggufa, miyyad vatteka kaf yerech yaakov.

Vela itnabbe bar nash mittamman ad deata shemuel. veal da netzach yisrael ketiv beh ki lo adam hu. yehoshua itnabbe mehodo shel moshe dichtiv (Bamidbar 27:20) venatatta mehodcha alav. hod. veda darga chamishaa. netzach yarcha semala deyaakov. uvegin kach ata david vechalil leh beyamina dichtiv, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha netzach. yemincha la ketiv ella bimincha.

May tama itchallash yarcha deyaakov, begin deitkarav beh setar mesaava venakit tukefa minneh veitakkev ad shemuel, veal da (Shemot 111 amud alef) ata leadkara deda ihu yarcha deyisrael dichtiv vegam netzach yisrael. veal da kol miloy havu bedina besheruta uvesofa.

Vetu kudesha berich hu kalil leh levatar behod. ematay levatar demashach malchin. veal da shakil ihu (teruma kemach amud alef) kemoshe veaharon. ma moshe veaharon bitren sitrin dilela, af hu letatta kegavvna deinnun teren sitre. uman innun. netzach vehod. kegavvna demoshe veaharon dilela. vechulhu dargin achidan da beda dichtiv, (Tehillim 99:6) moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo. deha shit sitrin itkelilu veachidan da beda.

Kema deillen achidan moshe veaharon ushemuel, uf hachi achidan (sefer acher da beda) yaakov moshe veyosef. yaakov mareh deveta. mit yaakov netal moshe beta umanne lah bechayyav. yosef al yede deyaakov umoshe hava tzaddik. (vetarvavyyhu lo shimsho beta ella beyosef begin dehava tzahek).

Yaakov beyosef natal beta dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef. moshe la shimmesh bah ad denatal leh leyosef. kad nafkat shechinta min galuta la yachil leizdavvga bah ella beyosef dichtiv, (Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo. ammay ketiv immo. ela gufa la izdavavg benukeva ad deizdavvavg bahade berit. veal da moshe natal leh leyosef immeh. kevan dehava immeh shimmesh benukeva kedka yeut. uvegin kach yaakov moshe veyosef kechada azle.

Yaakov mit vegufeh oolu leh beara kaddisha. yosef mit gufeh la itkkabbar beara kaddisha ela garmoy. moshe (mit) la hay vela hay. ammay. ella yaakov baalah kadmaa dematronita hava. mit yaakov izdavvga beh bemoshe. uveod dehava moshe behay alma mane lah kedka yeut veihu hava baalah tinyayna.

Yaakov ailu leh leara kaddisha gufeh shelim begin deihu gufa. yosef garmoy vela gufeh begin degarmin innun chayyaylin umashshiryayn dilela vechulhu nafke mehahu tzaddik. vetzaddik tzevaot ikre. may tama, begin dechol tzevaot umashshiryayn illain minneh nafkin. veal da garmoy deinnun tzevaot oolu beara.

Moshe hava levar vela al tamman la gufeh vela garmoy ella oolat shechinta beara. batar demit moshe veithadderat levaalah kadmaa vadday ihu yaakov. mikkan nukeva deitnesevat bitren, behahu alma ahadderat lekadmaa. moshe hava levar kevan devaalah kadmaa hava beara.

Moshe zacha bechayyav ma dela zacha beh yaakov. yaakov shimmesh bah behahu alma, moshe behay alma. vei tema digriu demoshe hava. lav hachi. ela kad nafke yisrael mimmitzrayim missitra deyovla hava. vechol innun shittin ravrevan mealma illaa havu.
42: Uvehahu diukena azlu bemadbera vechad minhon la alu veara. ella benehon toladin dilhon kedka chaze deinnun tikkuna desihara. vechol ovade ara tikkuna desihara hava.

Moshe shimmesh besihara beod deihu begufa umanne lah liruteh. kad itpattar mehay alma salik bisliku illaa berucha kaddisha veithaddar berucha leyovla ilaa vetamman itdabbeku beinnun shittin ribbo dehavu dileh. ma dela hava ken leyaakov dehu ithaddar berucha lego shemitta ma dela hava ken bechayyav (begin) kevan deveta ochora hava leh.

Veara kaddisha betikkuna (dealma nusach acher diltatta) ittakkanat bechela dilela. veal da la itchazun lemehve kulhu kechada. innun dealma illaa havu bilchodayyhu kulhu berucha. veinnun dealma tattaa havu bilchodayyhu kulhu begufa. vela itchazun lemeheve illen veillen go sihara. ela illen go sihara. veillen levar. lenahara illen miggo illen.
Vechulhu dealu beara diukena dekadmae havu. vela havu bisliku illaa kavvavtayyhu. begin dela yehe dara vela hava mikkadmat dena keinnun kadmae deitchazzeya lehon ziv yekara demarehon appin beappin.

Yaakov shimmesh binshoy begufa. levatar itdabbak rucha berucha. moshe itperash meitteteh veshimmesh kad ihu begufa behahu rucha kaddisha. levatar itdabbak rucha berucha illaa temira dilela. vechol dargin havu mitdabbekan kulhu kechada. rucha demoshe deyovla ihu gufeh dishmitta. rucha deyaakov leitdabbeka bishmitta, gufeh dinshoy hava behay alma.

Kol innun nehorin illain bediukena dilhon letatta beara (nusach acher bediyyukena dilhon letatta minnehon bediyyukena dilhon letatta beara) vechulhu talyayn birkia hashshamayim. hacha raza ditren shemahan kelilan kechada veshichlula dilhon telata veithadderan lechad da lokovel da. veihu shema gelifa mechakkeka kelilan behay beraza dimhemnuta:

Vayyomer elohim naase adam (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav vegomer patach hahu sava desavin veamar, shimon shimon man hu deamar vayyomer elohim naase adam. (vayyomer elohim) may nihu hacha hay elohim. adhachi parach hahu sava desavin vela chama leh. uchema dishma ribbi shimon dehava kare leh shimon vela ribbi shimon, amar lechavroy vadday hay hu kudesha berich hu deittemar beh (Daniel 7:9) veattik yomin yativ. ha kean ihu shaata lemiftach behay raza. devadday hacha it raza dela ityehiv reshu leitgalya. uchean mashma dirshuta ityehiv leitgalleya.

Patach veamar lemalka dehava leh kamma binyaynin lemivne. vehava leh umana. vehahu umana la hava avad middaam ella mershu demalka kema deat amer, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon. malka vadday ihu chachma illaa leela. veammuda deemtzaita (ihu) malka letatta. elohim umana leela veda ima illaa. elohim umana letatta veda shechinta (tikkunim amud bet daf 97 1) diltatta.

Veitteta let lah reshu lemebad middaam bela reshut baalah. vechol binyaynin dehavu beorach atziluta hava amar abba beamira legabbe imma yehe keden ucheden, umiyyad hava. kema deat amer vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. vayyomer hava amar lelohim, yehi or. mare devinyayna ihu omer veumana avid miyyad. vehachi kol binyaynin beorach atziluta hava amar yehi rakia, yehi meorot, vecholla itavid miyyad.

Kad mata lealma depiruda deihu olam hannivdalim, amar umana lemare binyayna naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu. amar mare binyayna vadday tav hu lemebad leh. aval atid hu lemechete kammach begin deihu kesil hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:1) ben chacham yesammach av uven kesil tugat immo.
Ihi amra batar dechoveh talya beimma vela beabba ana baina lemivre leh bediyyukena dili. hada hu dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vela baa leishtattafa beh abba.
43: (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shulcha immechem. amar malka leimma vela amarit lach deatid hu lemechote. behahu zimna tarich leh vetarich imma immeh. uvegin da ketiv, (Mishlei 10:1) ben chacham yesammach av uven kesil tugat immo. ben chacham, da adam deihu beorach atzilut. uven kesil, da adam divria.

Kamu kulhu chavrayay veamru ribbi ribbi, vechi it piruda ben abba veimma demissitra deabba ihu beorach atzilut umissitra deimma babberia. amar lon chavrayyay chavrayyay lav hachi hu, deha adam deatziluta dechar venukeva hava missitra deabba veimma. veda ihu vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. yehi or missitra deabba, vayhi or missitra deimma. veda ihu adam du partzufin.

Aval lehay let beh tzelem udemut. ella imma illaa hava leh chad kinnuy desalik lechusheban elohim. vehahu kinnuy ihu or vechoshech. uvegin hahu choshech dehava behahu kinnuy, amar abba deatid lemechote leadam deatzilut (nusach acher divria) deihu or levush illaa (nusach acher elyon).

Vehay ihu or debara kudesha berich hu beyom rishon dignazo letzaddikayyay. vehahu choshech deitbere beyoma kadmaa lerashshiayyay kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 2:9) ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu, uvegin hahu choshech dehava atid lemechote lehahu or, la baa abba leishtattafa beh. uvegin da amar naase adam betzalmenu hahu or. kidmutenu hahu choshech deihu levusha laor. kegavvna degufa deihu levusha lenishmeta hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 10:11) or uvasar talbisheni. chadu kulhu veamru zakkaa chulekana dezachina lemishma millin dela ishtemau ad kean.

Patach od ribbi shimon veamar (Devarim 32:39) reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi vegomer. amar chavrayyay shimu millin attikin debaena legallaa batar deityehiv reshu illaa lememar. may nihu deamar reu atta ki ani ani hu. ella da hu illat al kol illain. hahu deitkere illat haillot illat meillen illot. dela yaavid chad meillen illot shum ovada ad denatil reshut mehahu dealeh. kema deokimna leela benaase adam.

Naase vadday. al teren ittemar. deamar da lehahu dilela minneh naase. vela avid middaam ela birshu vaamira mehahu dilela minneh. vehahu dilela minneh la avid middaam ad denatil etza mechavreh. aval hahu deitkere illat al kol illot delet leela minneh vela letatta shav leh. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 40:25) veel mi tedamyuni veeshve yomar kadosh. amar reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi, denatil etza minneh. kegavvna dehahu deamar vayyomer elohim naase adam.

Kamu kulhu chavrayyay veamru ribbi hav lana reshu lemallala behay atar. amru veha la okmat leela deilot haillot amar lechtr naase adam. amar lon havu shemain udenayychu ma defumechon memallelan. veha la amarit lechu hasheta deit deitkere illat haillot velav ihu hahu deitkere illat al kol illot. delillat al kol illot let leh tinyayna denatil etza minneh deihu yachid kodam kolla velet leh shuttafa.

Uvegin da amar reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi denatil etza minneh, dela it leh tinyayna vela shuttafa velav chushebna. deit echad beshittuf kegon dechar venukeva veittemar behon (yeshaya na) ki echad kerativ aval ihu chad bela chusheban vela shittuf. uvegin da amar veen elohim immadi. kamu kulhu veishtattachu kammeh veamru zakkaa bar nash demareh issetkam immeh legallaa razin temirin dela havu mitgalleyayn lemalachayyay kaddishayyay.

Amar lon chavrayyay, it lan leashlama kera, dechamma razin temirin it behay kera. (Devarim 32:39) ani amit vaachayye vegomer ani amit vaachayye bisfiran. achayye missitra deyamina chayye. umissitra dismala mota. vei la istakkeman tarvayyhu beammuda deemtzaita la itkeyyaym dina. deinnun bemotav telata kechada.
44: Istekamu telata lemebad dina, veyete yad (yemina) deihi peshuta lekabbel shavim deihu Adonai yod hei vav hei. veda shechinta itkere yad yamin missitra dechesed. yad semol missitra digvura. yad Adonai missitra deammuda deemtzaita. kad bar nash tav bityuveta hay yad sheziv leh min dina. aval kad dan illat al kol haillot ittemar beh veen miyyadi matztzil.
Veod telat zimnin ittemar behay kera ani ani ani. deit behon 1 1 1 10 10 10. deitremizu beYod 15 vav 15, yod hei vav hei. veit behon 3 vavin 6 6 6 vaachayye vaani veen deitremizu beillen shemahan.

Veim kol da dehay kera ha ukemuha chavrayyay legabbe elohim acherim. kema deat amer reu atta ki ani ani hu, da kudesha berich hu ushechinteh deittemar behu ani vaho. veen elohim immadi da 131 venachash. ani amit vaachayye, ani amit bishchinti leman deihu chayyayv. vaani achayye bah leman deihu zakkay. veen miyyadi matzil da yad Adonai deihu Adonai, yod hei vav hei veihu 39 135 39 vecholla keshot. aval ma deittemar leela illat illaa deihu illat al kol haillot. vehay raza la itmasar lechol chakkima unevia (nusach acher aval ma deittemar leella al illaa deihu al healot hay raza lo itmesar ella lechol chakkima vanebayah).

Ta chaze kamma illot innun setimin deinnun mitlabbeshin veinnun murekavin bisfiran, usefiran merkava legabbayyhu, deinnun temirin mimmachashavta divne nesha, vealayyhu ittemar (Kohelet Adonai:7) ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer vegomer. nehorin metzuchetzachin illen al illen. veillen dimkabbelin innun chashochin meochoranin dealayyhu dimkabbelin minnayyhu. veillat (al kol) haillot let nehora kayyayma kammeh dechol nehorin mitchashchan kammeh.

Davar acher naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu, ha ukemuha chavrayyay al malache hashsharet deinnun amri hay kera. amar lehu batar dehavu yadin ma dehava uma deatid lemeheve veinnun havu yadin deatid lemechete ammay bau lemebad leh.

Vela od ella deazza vaazael havu mekatrege aleh bezimna deamar shechinta lekudesha berich hu naase adam, amru ma adam vattedaehu. ma at bae lemivre adam, vattedaehu deatid lemechete kammach beitteta dileh deihi choshech. deor (50 daf 28) ihu dechura vechoshech nukeva semala choshech divria. behahu zimna shechinta amarat lon behay deattun mekatregin attun atidim leminpal. kedichtiv vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam ki tovot henna vegomer (cheshko behon) vetau vehon veappil lon shechinta mikkedusha dilhon.

Amru chavrayyay ribbi ribbi, addehachi (nusach acher i hachi) azza vaazael la havu meshakrin bemillulayyhu. devadday benukeva atid adam lemechete. amar lehu hachi amra shechinta attun izdammantun lekatrega kodamay yattir mechela dimroma, i attun havetun shappirin meadam beovadayychu yaot lechu lekatrega aleh. aval ihu atid lemechete beitteta chada, attun binshin saggiin. chibbatechon yattir mibbene nesha kema dichtiv vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam vegomer, et bat haadam lo neemar, ella et benot haadam. velo od ella im adam chav ha akdim leh teshuva leahadara lemareh leatkana bamme dechav.

Amru leh chavrayyay (rabbi rabbi) i hachi ammay kule hay. amar ribbi shimon lechavrayyay i la dehava hachi devara kudesha berich hu yitzra tava uvisha deinnun or vechoshech la hava zechu vechova leadam divria. ella (begin) deitberi mittarvavyyhu, uvegin da (Devarim 30:15) ree natatti lefanycha hayyom et hachayyim vegomer. amru leh kule hay ammay. vela hava shappir dela itbere dela lemechav ulegarma kol ma degarim leela vela hava leh la onesh vela sachar.

Amar lon min haddin hava leh lemivreyeh kach. begin deorayyta begineh itberiat dichtiv ba onasha lerashshiayyay veagra letzaddikayyay vela hava agra letzaddikayyay veonasha lerashshiayyay ella begin adam divria (Yeshayahu 45:18) lo tohu beraah leshevet yetzarah. amru vadday kean shemana ma dela shemana ad hasheta, devadday la vera kudesha berich hu milleta delav ihu tzarich.
45: Ihu levusha dishchinta. vei adam la hava atid lemivre (lemechete) havat shechinta bela chissuyay kegavvna deani. uvegin da kol man dechav keillu afshit lishchinta malbushaha. vehay ihu onasha deadam.

Vechol man dimkayyem pikkudin deorayyta keillu hu lavish lishchinta bilvushaha. uvegin da ukemuha bechissuya detzitzit (utefillin) (Shemot 22:26) ki hi chesuto levaddah hi simlato leoro bamme yishkav begaluta veha ukemuha. ta chaze, choshech ihu uchemu deorayyta or chevru deorayyta.

(Vei tzelota lav ihi shelema kema Malachi chabbala radepayn avatrah kema deat ameraz, (Eicha 1:3) kol ravedapeyh hissiguha vegomer. uvegin da metzallin (Tehillim 78:38) vehu rachum yechapper avon da samael deihu nachash. velo yashchit da mashchit. veharebe lehashiv appo da af. velo yair kol chamato da chamma. begin dela yirdefun batar tzelota. vechamma Malachi chabbala talyayn minnayyhu. shiva memanan innun vetalyayn minnayyhu shivin. uvechol rekia varekayaa innun mekatregin vetalyayn minnayyhu esre elef ribbo.

Vei tzelota salleka shelema beittufa demitzva utefillin al resha 287 ittemar behu (Devarim 28:10-11) ureu kol ammi haaretz ki sham Adonai nikra alecha vayyiru mimmecha. sham Adonai ukemuha deihi tefillin deresha. uman dachazi sham Adonai al 511 bitzlota deihi (Adonai) adonay miyyad kullehon barechayn. hada hu 436 (Tehillim 91:7) yippol mitztziddecha elef vego).

Uvegin da amar kera (Bamidbar 23:9) ki merosh tzurim erennu. illen innun tziyyurin dishma kaddisha. vihon metzuyayrin beanpayyhu bitren luchin yakkirin deinnun 10 10 deihu 6 charut alayyhu.

Veod tziyyer lon lechol dor bevat zugeh ilaa da 15 veinnun 6 yichuda detarvavyyhu. vetzayyer lon beinnun detziyyura dilela deihu yisrael ammuda deemtzaita kalil shechinta illaa vetattaa deinnun keriat shema arvit ukeriat shema shacharit vealayyhu ittemar etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari.

Umiyyad behahu zimna nata lon leyisrael beginta deeden kaddisha hada hu dichtiv vayyitta Adonai (28 1) elohim abba veimma. gan da shechinta tattaa. eden da imma illaa. et haadam da ammuda deemtzaita. ihi tehe neta dileh, bat zugeh vela tazuz minneh lealam. utehe idduna dileh. veyisrael kudesha berich hu nata lon behahi zimna nita kaddisha bealma kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 60:21) netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer:

Vayyatzmach Adonai elohim. abba veimma. kol etz nechmad da tzaddik. vetov lemaachol da ammuda deemtzaita deveh hu zammin (nusach acher zemina) mazon lechola decholla beh. vela itparnes tzaddik ella minneh ushechinta minneh, vela tzerichin letattain (dilhon). ella kulehu nizzonin letatta al yadeh. divgaluta la hava lishchinta ulechy almin mezona ella bechy birchan ditzlota. aval behahu zimna ihu yehe mezona lecholla.

Veetz hachayyim dehu ilana dechayye yehe netia bego ginta deittemar beh (Bereshit 3:22) velakach gam meetz hachayyim veachal vachay leolam. ushechinta la shalta alah ilana desitra ochora deinnun erev rav deinnun (sof tetze) etz haddaat tov vara. velo tekabbel bah od tame hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar. uvegin da la mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach. utehe shechinta kegafna dela mekabbela nita mimmina ochora.

Veyisrael yehon kol etz nechmad lemare. veyitchazzar alayyhu shufera deittemar beh (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz tiferet yisrael. veetz haddaat tov vara idachyayn minnayyhu vela mitdabbekin vela mitarvin behon. deha ittemar beyisrael umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu deinnun erev rav. vegale lon kudesha berich hu devyom achlo mimmennu garmu deavdu 2 avdin deinnun bayit rishon uvayit sheni. da ihu ki veyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut 2 peamim. veinnun gerimu detzaddik yechorav veyavesh bevayit rishon deihi shechinta illaa, uvevayit sheni deihi shechinta tattaa. da ihu (Yeshayahu 19:5) venahar yechorav veyavesh. venahar da (nusach acher 6) yechorav baAdonai tattaa begin deistallak minneh neviu dey leen sof.

Umiyyad deyifkun yisrael min galuta amma kaddisha lechud, miyyad nahar dehava charev veyavesh ittemar beh venahar yotze meeden da 6 lehashekot et haggan. venahar da ammuda deemtzaita. yotze meeden da imma illaa, lehashekot et haggan da shechinta tattaa.
Divhahu zimna ittemar bemoshe uveyisrael (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai beong deihu 70 eden 50 nahar 3 gan. veitkeyyaym kera (Shemot 15:1) az yashir moshe vegomer
51: Shar lo neemar ella yashir. veithappach leerav rav oneg lenega uleumin dealma ovde kochavim umazzalot kegavvna defaro umitzrae defarach behon shechin avabuot. aval leyisrael yehe oneg.

Veda ihu venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. deinnun chesed deroa yamina. uvehahu zimna harotze lehachekim yadrim. umachane michael itshakyayn minneh veimmeh matte yehuda uteren shivtin. gevura deroa semala. uvehahu zimna harotze lehaashir yatzpin. umachane gavriel itshakyayn minneh veimmeh matte dan uteren shivtin. netzach shoka yamina uminnah itshakyayn mashshiryay denuriel veimmeh matte reuven uteren shivtin immeh. hod shoka semala dealah ittemar leyaakov (Bereshit 32:32) vehu tzolea al yerecho uminneh itshakyayn mashshiryay dirfael deihu memanna al asvavta degaluta veimmeh matte efrayim uv shivtin.

Davar acher umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim illen innun arbaa denichnesu lappardes. chad al befishon deihu pi shone halachot. tinyayna al begichon. vetamman hu kavur hahu deittemar beh (Vayikra 11:42) kol holech al gachon, gavriel gavar el aleh ittemar (Iyov 3:23) legever asher darko nistara vayyasech eloah baado. velo yada gevar yat kevureteh ad yoma haden deitgalyay tamman. veda ihu remez ulechakkima birmiza.

Telitaa al bachiddekel chad kal veda lishna chadida kalla lidrasha. reviaa al bapperat deihu mocha deveh periyya ureviyya. ben zoma uven azay dealu biklifin deorayyta havu lakan behon. ribbi akiva (pikkude 254 amud alef) deal bemocha ittemar beh deal bishlam venafak bishlam.

(Amar rabbi elazar, abba, yoma chad havena beve midderasha, usheilu chavrayyay may nihu deamar rabbi akiva latelameydevay keshettaggiu leavne sheyyesh tahor el tomru mayim mayim shemma tasetakenaven garmayychu dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yechavven leneged ene. addehachi ha sava dasebayn ka nachit amar lon rabbanan, bemay ka tashetadelaven. amro leh vadday beha deamar rabbi akiva latelameydevay keshettaggiu leavne sheyyesh vechulei. amar lon vadday raza illaa it hacha. veha ukemuha bimtivta illaa. uvegin dela titteun nacheytenaa lechu uvegin (deitgalya) raza da benayychu deihi raza illaa temira mibbene dara.

Bevadday avne sheyyesh tahor innun deminnehon mayin dachyayn nafkin. veinnun remizin bata 1 resha vesofa. 6 deihu natuy benayyhu ihu etz hachayyim. man deachil minneh vachay lealam. veillen 2 80 innun remizin baveyytzar. veinnun teren yetzirot. yetzira deillain vitzira detattain. veinnun chachma berosh vechachma besof. taalumot chachma. vadday innun taalumot mechachma illaa ditchot keter illaa.

Veinnun lekabbel 2 ayynin divhon (Shemot 18 1) teren dimin nachtu beyamma Rava. veammay nachtu. begin deorayyta muttarin luchin illen hava moshe nachit leyisrael. velo zachu behon veitbaru venaflu. veda garim abevadea devet rishon ushene. veammay naflu begin defarach 6 minnayyhu deihu 6 daveyytzar. veyahiv lon acharanin missitra deetz haddaat tov vara demittamman ityeyhivat orayyta beissur vehetter mimina chayye umissemala mota.

Uvegin da amar rabbi akiva latelameydevay keshettaggiu leavne sheyyesh tahor el tomru mayim mayim. lo tahevav shekilin avne sheyyesh tahor (nusach acher deinnun 2 yodin daveyytzar chachma illaa vechachma tattaa) laabaneyn acharanin deinnun chayye umota demittamman (Kohelet 10:2) 32 chacham limino. velev kesil lismolo. velo od ella attun tasetakenaven garmayychu. begin deillen deetz haddaat tov vara innun befiruda. veavne sheyyesh tahor innun beyichuda belo piruda kelal. vei temrun deha istallak etz hachayyim minnayyhu venaflu veit piruda benayyhu. dover shekarim lo yechavven leneged ene deha let tamman piruda leella. deillen deittebaru meinnun havo. oto lenashshaka
52: Davar acher venahar yotze meeden. bevadday leela beetz chayyim tamman let kelippin nucherain hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra. aval beetz diltatta it kelippin nucherain vadday. veihu natua beginta deeden dizer appin. deihu chanoch metatron degan eden dilela. dekudesha berich hu let tamman artuma, lemeheve tamman niftal veikkesh. uvegin da venahar yotze vegomer veyachilna lememar bemototoron yotze meeden meiddun dileh. lehashekot et haggan gan dileh pardes (tikun 24) dileh detamman alu ben azay uven zoma veelisha. ukelippin dileh missitra da tov umissitra da ra. veda issur vehetter kasher ufasul tumea vetohora.

Kam chad sava veamar ribbi ribbi hachi hu vadday. aval etz chayyim la itkere ihu. ella hachi hu raza demilla vayyitzer chad yetzira detov vechad yetzira dera. da ihu etz haddaat tov vara. etz da adam zeera missitra dechayyim minneh umissitra demota minneh. tamman 2 yetzirot dileh deinnun issur vehetter, vealeh ittemar vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama.

Vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim. da shechinta illaa. eden teyuveta. vealah ittemar veetz hachayyim betoch haggan da ammuda deemtzaita. haggan shechinta tattaa. telat ketirin innun nishmata rucha nafsha legabbeh. uvehon vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya. deihu mippiv mammash itkere lishchinta deihi nishmat chayyim. miyyad deamar millin illen salik leela. amar ribbi shimon chavrayay bevadday malacha hava. uvevadday samich it lana mikkol atar.

Patach kera avatreh: vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu began eden vegomer. vayyikkach mean natil leh. ella natil leh med yesodin deittemar behon umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. afrish leh minnehon veshavve leh beginta deeden.

Kegavvna da yaaved kudesha berich hu lebar nash deitbere med yesodin. bezimna detav bityuveta umitassek beorayyta. kudesha berich hu natil leh mittamman. vealayyhu ittemar umishsham yippared. afrish nafsheh mittaava dilhon veshavve leh beginta dileh deihi shechinta. leavdah befikkudin dease. uleshamrah befikkudin delo taase. i zacha lenatra lah ihu yehe resha al 4 yesodin. veitavid nahar deitshakyayn al yadeh vela al yeda achara veishtemodin beh deihu ribbon veshallit alayyhu.

Vei avar al orayyta itshakyayn mimmeriru deilana dera deihu yetzer hara. vechol evarin deinnun med yesodin ittemar behon (Shemot 1:14) vaymararu et chayyehem vegomer vaymararu bimriru demara. ulegabbe evarin kaddishin degufa deinnun missitra detov alayyhu ittemar (Shemot 15:23) vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara vegomer. kegavvna da amru mare matnitin vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha bekusheya. bechomer bekal vachomer. uvilvenim belibbun hilcheta. uvechol avoda bassade da barayyta. et kol avodatam vegomer da mishna.

Im tayyvin bityuveta ittemar behon (Shemot 15:25) vayyorehu Adonai etz. veda etz chayyim uveh vayyimteku hammayim. veda moshe mashiach deittemar beh (Shemot 17:9) umatte haelohim beyado. matte da metatron missitreh chayyim umissitreh mita. kad ithappach lematte ihu ezer missitra detov. kad ithappach lechivya ihu kenegdo. miyyad (Shemot 4:3) vayyanas moshe mippanav.

Vekudesha berich hu mesar leh bida demoshe veihu orayyta dival pe deveh issur vehetter. miyyad (leel 6 amud bet) demacha beh betinara netal leh kudesha berich hu bideh. veittemar beh (Shmuel 2 23:21) vayyered elav bashshavet limchaa leh beh. veshevet ihu yetzer hara chivya. vecholla ihu begaluta mechamat dileh.
Veod umishsham yippared. zakkaa ihu bar nash deishtaddal beorayyta. debzimna denatil leh kudesha berich hu mehay gufa med yesodin, itperash mittamman veazil lemeheve resha bed
53: Chevavn veittemar behon al kappayim yissaunecha vegomer:

Vaytzav Adonai elohim vegomer ha ukemuha let tzav ella avoda zara demittamman elohim acherim veihi bakkaved. deminnah tichbad haavoda deihi avoda zara leh vehakkaved koes. veha ukemuha kol hakkoes keillu oved avoda zara da ihu vaytzav.

Al haadam da shefichut damim kema deat amer, (Bereshit 9) baadam damo yishshafech. veda mara charba demalach hammavet kema deat amer, (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara kelaana chadda kecherev piyyot. lemor da gilluy arayot veda techol aleh ittemar (Mishlei 30:20) achla umachata piha vegomer ditchol let leh puma vearkin veitshakya meachiru dedama uchema dechaved vela ashkachna leh puma. veda ihu achla umachata piha vegomer. kol shofche damim mimmara innun. dearkin didma delibba miyyad dechazan mara kulhon barchin kodamah.

Veeryayn kulhu itkasyayn bachashocha bedam uchema ditchol. man deavar al shefichat dema veavoda zara vegilluy arayot galya nishmeteh bechaved mara techol vedayynin leh baggehinnam utelat memannan alayyhu mashchit af vechema.

15 Eryayn innun kechushban 15. veshit ochoranin kechushban 6. kodam degalu yisrael begaluta ushechinta immehon. mane kudesha berich hu leyisrael (Vayikra 18:13) ervat imcha lo tegalle. veda galuta ihu gilluy ervata dishchinta hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shulcha imchem. veal gilluy arayot galu yisrael ushechinta begaluta. veda ihi erva dishchinta. vehay erva ihi lilit imma deerev rav. veerev rav innun arayot dilah vaarayot deyisrael dilela dealeh ittemar (Vayikra 18:8) ervat avicha lo tegalle.

Veinnun afrishin ben Adonai Adonai dela itkeriv 6 benayyhu hada hu dichtiv, (achare mot 74) ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle. veinnun shechinta illaa vetattaa. debzimna deerev rav deinnun (70 123 270) nefilim gibborim amalekim refaim anakim ben Adonai Adonai, let reshu lekudesha berich hu lekarva benayyhu. veraza demilla (Yeshayahu 19:5) venahar yechorav veyavesh yechorav baAdonai illaa veyavesh baAdonai tattaa. begin dela yitparnesun erev rav min 6 deihu etz hachayyim. uvegin da let kerivu lev ben Adonai Adonai bezimna deerev rav benayyhu.

Velet reshu leat 10 lekarava baAdonai tinyayna hada hu dichtiv ervat kallatcha lo tegalle. veinnun afrishu ben 6 laAdonai illaa hada hu dichtiv ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle. dey ihu av. Adonai em. 6 ben. Adonai bat. uvegin da mane legabbeh Adonai illaa. ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle. ervat achotcha bat avicha da Adonai tattaa. et bat benah veet bat bittah innun hei hei deinnun toladin de. ervat achi avicha da yod deihu tolada deat 10 veihu ach levv.

Sof sof bezimna deerev rav meoravin beyisrael let kerivu veyichuda beatvavn shem Adonai, umiyyad deyitmachun mealma ittemar beatvavn dekudesha berich hu (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. uvegin da adam deinnun yisrael it lon yichuda beorayyta deitmmar bah (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah. veihi matronita malchut. demissitraha itkeriu yisrael bene melachim.

Uvegin da amar kudesha berich hu lo tov hyot haadam levaddo eese lo ezer kenegdo da mishna itteta dehahu naar veihu (nusach acher veihi) shifcha dishchinta. vei zachu yisrael ihi ezri lon begaluta missitra dehetter tahor kasher. vei lav ihi kenegdo missitra detame pasul asur. tahor hetter kasher ihu yetzer hattov. pasul tame asur ihu yetzer hara.

Veitteta deit lah dam tohar vedam nidda missitra demishna ihi shavya leh velav ihi bat zugeh yichuda dileh. delet yichuda ad deerev rav yitmachun mealma. uvegin da (leel 26 amud bet) itkevar moshe levar meara kaddisha. ukevureta dileh mishna ihi vela yada gevar yat kevureteh ad yoma haden. kevureta dileh mishna deshalta al matronita deihi kabbala lemoshe. umalka umatronita
54: Mitparsha mibbaalah. begin da (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vechulei tachat eved ki yimloch da ihu avda yedia. veshifcha da mishna. venaval ki yisba lachem da erev rav, am naval velo chacham.

Od patach veamar. vayyitzer Adonai elohim min haadama kol chayyat hassade vechol of hashshamayim. vavy lealma deinnun attimin libba usetimin ayynin dela mistakkelin beraze deorayyta vela yadin. devadday chayyat hassade veof hashshamayim innun amme haaretz. veafillu beillen deinnun nefesh chayya la ishtechach ezer behon (begaluta) lishchinta begaluta vela lemoshe deihu imma. debchol zimna degalat shechinta la zaz minnah.
Amar ribbi elazar veha man yahiv ovada deadam beyisrael uvemoshe. amar leh beri veant amart hachi vechi la olifat (Yeshayahu 46:10) maggid mereshit acharit. amar leh hachi hu vadday.

Uvegin da moshe la mit veadam itkere ihu. uvegineh ittemar begaluta batraa uleadam la matza ezri ella kulhu kenegdo. vechen ammuda deemtzaita ittemar beh uleadam la matza ezri deappik shechinteh min galuta hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 2:12) vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish. umoshe ihu bediyyokneh mammash deittemar beh la matza ezer kenegdo.

Behahu zimna vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al haadam. Adonai elohim abba veimma. tardema da galuta deittemar beh (Bereshit 15:12) vetardema nafla al avram. arame leh al moshe vayyishan. let shena ella galuta. vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav. mitztzalotav deman. ella meillin ulemin dematronita netalu abba veimma chad minnayyhu veihu sitra chivavra. yafe challevana. vayyisgor basar tachtenna, da basar deittemar beh beshaggam hu basar basar demoshe sumak. vealeh ittemar pene moshe kifne chamma. uvegin da (Shir HaShirim 6:10) yafa challevana bara kachamma.

Davar acher vayyisgor basar baan laagana bah aleh hada hu dichtiv vayyisgor Adonai baado. davar acher vayyisgor kema deat amer, (lo amud alef) (Shemot 25:27) leumat hammisgeret, misgeret mitkayyemet, devah matronita (Yechezkel 46:1) yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase:

Vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela, hacha (491 280 amud bet) itremiz raza deyivum deamru beh kevan shello bana shuv lo yivne, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 25:9) asher lo yivne et bet achiv. aval legabbe kudesha berich hu, ittemar beh vayyiven Adonai elohim abba veimma bane lah legabbeh hada hu dichtiv bone yerushalayim Adonai. 6 deihu ben 15 abba veimma. alayyhu ittemar vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela. asher lakach min haadam da ammuda deemtzaita. vayvieha el haadam ayyte leh legabbe tzela denatil min Adonai ulema dilah.

Vealah ittemar (Zecharya 2:9) vaani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv. uvegin da betura da itbene be mikdesha. al yeda dekudesha berich hu yehe kayyayma (50 daf 119) ledare darin. vealeh ittemar (Chagai 2:9) gadol yihye kevod habbayit hazze haacharon min harishon. dekadmaa itbene al yeda devar nash vehay al yeda dekudesha berich hu. uvegin da (Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yivne vayit shav amlu vonav bo.

Vechen ittemar bemoshe vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela. kema deat amer, (Shemot 26:20) uletzela hammishkan hashshenit. tzela vadday missitra dechesed chivvavr mittamman itkeriat sihara. vayyisgor basar tachtenna (tikun 21 26 amud bet) basar deihu sumak missitra digvura veitkelil betarvavyyhu. behahu zimna (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni.

Zot happaam etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari da shechinta naara hameorasa legabbe ammuda deemtzaita ittemar ba zot happaam vegomer ana yadana deihi etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari. lezot vadday yikkare ishsha missitra illaa deihi imma. ki meish lukkacha zot, missitra deabba deihu 10. vechen moshe bediukena dileh letatta.

Behahu zimna yizku yisrael kol chad vechad levat zugeh. veda ihu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:26) venatatti lachem lev chadash veruach chadasha etten bekirbechem uchetiv, (Yoel 3:1) venibbeu benechem uvenotechem vegomer veillen
55: Innun nishmatin chadtin deatidin lemeheve al yisrael. kema deukemuha en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol neshamot shebbagguf veaz hachadashot yavou.

Behahu zimna mitabberin erev rav mealma, veittemar beyisrael uvemoshe kol chad bevat zugayyhu vayyihyu shenehem arumim haadam veishto velo yitboshashu. deitavar erva mealma deillen innun degarmu galuta, erev rav vadday.

Vealayyhu ittemar. vehannachash hayu arum mikkol chayyat hassade vegomer arum lera mikkol chevan deumin dealma ovde kochavim umazzalot. veinnun benoy denachash hakkadmoni defatte lechavva. veerev rav vadday innun havu zuhama deattil nachash bechavva. umehahi zuhama nafak kayin vekatal lehevel roe tzon deittemar beh beshaggam hu basar beshaggam ze hevel. beshaggam vadday ihu mshe vekatil leh veihu hava bera buchera deadam.

Veim kol da moshe begin lechassaa al eryayta deavuhi netal bat yitro deittemar beh (Shoftim 1:16) uvene keni choten moshe, veha ukemuha ammay itkere keni shennifrad mikkayin. kema deat amer, (Shoftim 4:11) vechever hakkeni nifrad mikkayin. ulevatar baa leahadara erev rav bityuveta lechassaa eryeyta deavuhi. dekudesha berich hu machashava tova metzarfah lemaase, veamar leh kudesha berich hu miggiza bisha innun, tistammar minnayyhu. illen innun chova deadam deamar leh umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu. illen innun chova demoshe veyisrael.

Uveginayyhu galu yisrael begaluta veittarchu mittamman hada hu dichtiv vaygaresh et haadam. veadam yisrael vadday. umoshe beginayyhu ittarech meatreh vela zacha lemeal beara deyisrael. divginayyhu avar maamar dekudesha berich hu vechav bassela demcha beh dela amar leh ella (Bamidbar 20:8) vedibbartem el hassela veinnun garmu. veim kol da machashava tova hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase deihu la kabbil lon veyahiv behon ot berit ella lechassaa eryayta deavuha. vekudesha berich hu amar leh (Bamidbar 14:12) veeese otcha legoy gadol veatzum mimmennu. uveginayyhu amar (Shemot 32:33) mi asher chata li emchennu missifri, deinnun mizzara deamalek deittemar beh (Devarim 25:19) timche et zecher amalek veinnun gerama letabbera teren luchin deorayyta. umiyyad.

Vattippakachna eni shenehem vayyedu yisrael ki erumim hem betuna demitzrayim dehavu bela orayyta veittemar behu (Yechezkel 16:7) veat erom veerya. veiyyov begin da amar 2 zimne (Iyov 1:21) arom yatzati mibbeten immi vearom ashuv shamma. ma dehava mshe ithappach leerev rav leshamma velishnina. ashuv shamma hacha remiz deatid leitchazzera benayyhu begaluta batraa veazil benayyhu leshamma veihu amar (Iyov 1:21) Adonai natan vaAdonai lakach yehi shem Adonai mevorach.

Uvezimna deittabberu teren luchin deorayyta. veorayyta deal pe ittemar behon vayyitperu ale teena. itkassu bechamma kelippin meerev rav begin ki erumim hem dela yitgalle eryatayyhu. vechissuyay dilhon kanfe tzitzit uretzuin ditfilin. alayyhu ittemar. vayyaas Adonai elohim laadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem. aval legabbe tzitziot vayyitperu ale teena. vayyaasu lahem chagorot da ihu (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor. veda keriat shema deittemar beh (Tehillim 149:6) rommot el bigronam vegomer. da hu vayyaasu lahem chagorot:

Vayyishmeu et kol Adonai elohim vegomer kad kerivu letura desinay. hada hu dichtiv (Devarim 4:33) hashama am kol elohim medabber mittoch haesh vegomer veerev rav mitu. veinnun havu deamru lemoshe (Shemot 20:16) veal yedabber immanu elohim pen namut veashkachu orayyta. veillen innun amme haaretz deittemar behon (Devarim 27:21) arur shochev im kol behema begin deinnun missitra dehahu chivya deittemar beh arur atta mikkol habbehema.

Veha kamma irbuvin innun bishin beiran vechevavn. aval it irbuveya missitra denachash. veit irbuveya missitra deume ovde kochavim umazzalot dedamu lechevavn uveiran dechakla. veit irbuveya missitra demazzikin denishmatan
56: Dechayyayvaya innun mazzikin dealma mammash. veit irbuveya deshedim veruchin velilin vecholla meorvavin beyisrael. vela it bechulhu latyay kaamalek deihu chivya bisha el acher. ihu galuy lechol eryayn dealma rotzeach ihu uvat zugeh sam mavet avoda zara. vecholla 131. veit 131 veit 131, velav kulhu shavyayn. aval hahu sitra dechivya ihu latyay al kolla.

Vayyikra Adonai elohim el haadam vayyomer lo ayyekka. hacha remiz leh deatid lecharva be makdesha ulemivke bah echa. hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 1:1) echa yashva vadad 11 25. ulezimna deate atid kudesha berich hu levaara kol zinin bishin mealma kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach. keden tav kolla leatreh kedichtiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad:

Taninan kol shelomo deittemar beshir hashshirim bemalka dishlama dileh. bemelech (sefer acher benukeve malka) setam benukeva. milla (nusach acher melech) tattaa beillaa. veraza demilla dirata tattaa leillaa tarvavyyhu kechad. vehayenu bayit dichtiv, (haazinu 291 1) (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yivne bayit. uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 3:9) appiryon asa lo hammelech shelomo meatze hallevanon. appiryon da tikkuna dealma tattaa mealma illaa.

Dead la bara kudesha berich hu alma hava satim shemeh beh vela (nusach acher hava) hu shemeh satim begavveh chad vela kayyma milla (vehu hava bilchodoy) ad desalik biruta (demachashava lekayyeyma kolla bametaven dasemaytarea) lemivre alma vehava rashim uvane vela kayyma, ad deitattaf beittufa chad dezihara (illaa demachashava) uvara alma (nusach acher yemina dealma kadmaa) (nusach acher shamayim).

Veappik (ilanin) arazin illain ravrevin mehahu nehora (nusach acher vazeyvea Rava) zihara illaa (nusach acher chad dazehar yemina illaa), veshavve retichu al teren veesrin atvavn reshimin itgelifu beeser amiran veityayshvu. hada hu dichtiv meatze hallevanon. uchetiv, (vayyetze 162 2) (Tehillim 104:16) arze levanon asher nata (deha meillen avid hahu appiryon).

Asa lo hammelech shelomo, lo legarmeh, lo letikkuneh, lo leachzaa yekara illaa. lo leodaa deihu chad ushemeh chad kema deat amer, (Zecharya 14:9) (yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad uchetiv) (Tehillim 83:19) veyedu ki atta shimcha Adonai levaddecha.
Bematun dekalfoy. kastorin yedia. natif lesitra da leela. natif leyamina. seta lismala. nachit letatta. vechen learba zavyayn. malchu itperash leela vetatta ulearba zavyayn lemehve chad. nahara illaa

Nachit letatta. veavid leh yamma rabba. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam ennnu male. deha hu kanish kolla veshaiv leh begavvih. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:1) ani chavatztzelet hashsharon shoshannat haamakim. veen sharon ela atar yamma rabba deshaiv kol memin dealma deappik veshaiv venahir (vealin beh. begine kach da appik veda shaiv, nahir) da beda beorchin yedian (nachlayay chafan illuye). ucheden alayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yivne bayit. veal da bet bereshit. (nusach acher veal da bet dealma melech setam) (bet illaa itbene bechachma. vechen tattaa uf hachi). aval beta illaa ravreva yishshuva dealma. melech setam beta tattaa.

(Tehillim 63:12) vehammelech yismach belohim, (24 ittear gevura) illaa leachda beh techot resheh ulekarva leh bechedva lemehve kolla chad. vehammelech yismach belohim chadu nehora deappik (nusach acher binhora) (denahara) denafik bechad shevila tamir veganiz veayyil beh (2, teren) deinnun chad veal da alma ishtachlal bekiyyuma shelim.

Vehammelecha yismach belohim alma (nusach acher nahara illaa) tattaa chade bealma illaa (nusach acher setima hahu deshaddar) amika (chidu denagid venafik bean atar chadde. belohim. beh chadde. beh shaddar) chayyim lecholla. chayye malka ikrun. da ikkara
57: Deveta. beta da bane beta dealma. uvane alma. veda hu bereshit bara elohim 2 reshit. reshit chachma kad kanish kolla legavveh veitavid yamma rabba leshaava kolla.

Yamma dekafu memoy. shaiv kol memin dealma. vechanish lon legaveh. umayin azlin veshatin veishtaavan beh. veda nafik miggo illaa. vesimaneh deraza da (Iyov 38:29) mibbeten mi yatza hakkarach dememoy gelidin beh leshaava ochoranin.

Hay karach (lekamman nov 1) yamma dekafa la nagdin memoy. ella beshaata detukepa dedarom mate legabbeh umakriv leh bahadeh. keden maya dehavu gelidin besitra detzafon mishtaran venagdin. deha missitra detzafon gelide mayya umissitra dedarom mishteran. venagdin leashkaa kol innun chevat bera kema deat amer (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday vegomer veillen ikrun hare vater turin defiruda. dechulhu mishtakyayn kad sitra dedarom share lekarva bahadeh. ucheden mayya nagdin. uvechela da illaa denagid kolla havu birvu bechedu.

Kad machashava salik biru (dechedva) mitmira dechol temirin. mate (veitnegid) miggavvih chad nahar. (kitra temira) vechad mitkarvin da beda bechad shevil dela yedia leela vetatta vehacha hu reshita decholla. uv melech setam mehay rishita ishtachlal vedame da leda.

(Uvechela da) bara elohim et hashshamayim, (setama nekuda setima denagdin memoy venafkin bara) (nusach acher batar denafkin beda) (57 nahara denafik beHei illaa) (57 nehora denagid veappik beda) veappik kol miggavvih. veda ikre kol hashshofar. vehayeynu bara elohim et hashshamayim (veihu) deihu kol hashshofar (nusach acher veihu hashshofar). veshamayim shallitin bechayye hammelech illaa al ara. vesimanich ben yishshay chay al haadama. dechayyim talyayn beven yishshay. (21 nagdin leh). uvehu shallit becholla. veara minneh itzenat. hada hu dichtiv veet haaretz. vav deittosaf leshaltaa bimzone al ara.

Et leela vehu chela dichlala deesrin uteren atvavn deappik et 1 400 elohim da veyahiv lashshamayim kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) baatara sheitra lo immo beyom chatunato. vehayeynu et hashshamayim leachlala da beda ulechabbera lon da beda leitkayyeyma kechada beinnun chayye malka melech setam leitzena mineh shamayim. veet haaretz chibbura diddechar venukeva deitgelifu beatvan reshimin. vechayye malka deitnegidu min shemaya deshamayim nagdin lon lekayyeyma ara vechol uchlosin dilah.
Veraza deelohim illaa avad shamayim vaaretz lekiyyuma. veappik lon kechada bechela dilela reshita dechola. kegavvna da raza illaa nachit letatta. vehay batraa avid shamayim vearetz letatta.

Veraza decholla 2 teren almin ninhu uverau almin. da alma illaa veda alma tattaa. da kegavvna deda. da bera shamayim vaaretz. veda bera shamayim vaaretz. veal da 2 teren almin ninhu. da appik teren almin. veda appik teren almin, vecholla bechela dereshit illaa.

Nachit illaa betattaa veitmalyay beorach dechad darga deshare alah. kegavvna dehahu shevil satim vetamir veganiz leela. bar dechad shevil dakkik. vechad orach. hahu diltatta orach kema deat amer, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga. vehahu dilela shevil dakik kedichtiv, (Iyov 28:7) nativ lo yedao ayit. veraza decholla (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech uvemayim azzim netiva. uchetiv, (Tehillim 77:20) bayyam darkecha ushevilcha bemayim rabbim. alma illaa kad itmalyay veitabbera kenukeva demitabbera min dechura appikat teren benin kechad, dechar venukeva, veinnun shamayim vaaretz kegavvna illaa.

Mimmemoy dishmaya ittezan ara umemoy ishtaddan begavvav, ella deillae dechar vetattae nukeva. vetattae min dechura itteznan. umayin tattain karan leillain kenukeva difticha lidchura veshadat maya lokovel maya didchura lemebad zara. venukeva min dechura itteznat. hada hu dichtiv veet haaretz betosefet 22 kema deittemar.
Ketiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi bara elle vegomer. atvavn itchakku
58: Beovada decholla. beovada deillaa uveovada detattaa. levatar itreshimu atvavn veitchakku bakkera. 2 bereshit bara. 1 elohim et. 2 reshit bara vadday. kema deittemar 412 bara vadday bechela illaa (bitkifu deraza deinnun atvavn). 2 nukeva. 1 dechar. kema dev bara vadday bechela dilela. hachi 1 appik atvavn hashshamayim kelala deesrin utartin atvavn. Adonai appik shamayim lemehav leh chayyin (nusach acher uleashkaa) uleashrasha leh.

Veet haaretz. 6 appik haaretz lemehav lah mezona uleatkana lah ulemehav lah sippuka deitchazze lah. veet haaretz, denatil vav et kelala deesrin uteren atvavn umittezan ara. veara kalil lon legavvav kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam. vehayeynu raza veet haaretz. dechanish kolla legavvav vekabbelit lon haaretz natla haaretz. veet da shamayim vaaretz kechada. et hashshamayim raza deshamayim vaaretz kechada (haaretz natelayt 6).

Vekabbilat lon leittezana. matun milla bekulefoy shechiche. kusetra dekutera beara shechiach. kad esha dimlahata nagid veitar missemala achid bah vesalka tenana kema deat amer (Shemot 19:18) vehar sinay ashan kullo mippeni asher yarad alav Adonai baesh. da esha veda tenana. uchetiv, (Shemot 19:18) veet hahar ashen. miggo deesha kad nachit achidan da beda tenana beesha. ucheden bistar semala kayyma kolla. vehayeynu raza (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda aretz. vimini tippecha shamayim. bechela deyamina leela. ki hay gavvna itavidu shemaya deihu dechar. udechar missitra deyamina ka ate venukeva missitra dismala. (leel 1 amud bet).

(Yeshayahu 40:26) seu marom enechem ureu mi bara elle. ad hacha istalleku millin dela leshaala kedilela. dechachma ishtachlel meayin vela kayyma leshaala desatim veamik let deyekum beh. kevan deitpashshat nehora amika nehoreh kayyma bishelta af al gav deihu satim mikkolla diltatta. vekaran leh al pum sheelta mi. mi bara elle.

Vehayenu raza dekaamran (lekamman pe amud bet) (Iyov 38:29) mibbeten mi yatza hakkarach. mibbeten mi vadday (yatza hakkerach) hahu dekayyma lishelta. velet leshaala ma leela ma letatta. ella leshaala atar denafkan leminda. vela leminda leh. deha la yachlin. ela kayyma lishelta vela leminda beh.

Bereshit 2 reshit. reshit maamar hu. o nima divreshit ihu maamar. ella ad la nafik veitpashshat cheleh (leel 15 amud bet) vecholla satim beh. bereshit ihu umaamar ihu. kevan denafik veitpeshat minneh chelin, reshit ikre vehu maamar bilchodoy. mi sheelta hahu devara elle. levatar kad itpeshat veishtachlal itavid 50 uvara letatta. vecholla avid kehahu gavvna mammash dilela. da lokovel da veda kegavvna deda. vetarvavyyhu 2.

Ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo. bimsibbo leityayshva bemalchu tattaa. beraza dehahu chavruta vetafnuka dehahu chavivuta diveden illaa behahu shevil desatim veganiz vela ityeda veitmalyay minneh venafka benachalin yedian. nirdi natan recho da malka tattaa. devara alma letatta kegavvna dilela vesalik recha tava illaa leshaltaa ulemebad veyachil veshallit venahir binhora illaa.

Bitren gavvnin itbere alma, beyamina uvismala beshitta yomin illain. shitta yomin itavidu leanhara kema deat amer (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. veillen karun archin veavadu shitin nukevin lithoma rabba. veinnun shitin nukevin leaalaa maya denachale go tehoma. veal da (ha tanenan) hashshitin mishsheshet yeme vereshit nivreu veinnun havu shelama dealma:

Vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu sosfita dekamre go koltoy dehava bekadmita vela itkayymat. hayta kevar ulevatar itkayyeymat. bearbein uteren atvavn itgelif alma veitkayymat. vechulhu ittura dishma kaddisha.
59: Atvavn leela venachtin letatta mitatteran beitrin bearba sitre alma veyachil alma leitkayyma. veillen itkayymin beovadoy dealma (nusach acher demalka). tufesra dekilta behane shechiche (kachevatemaa) degushepanka. alu unefaku et veet veitbere alma. alu go chotama veitztarfu veitkeyyaym alma.

Bekolfe dechivya ravreva machu vealu techot nukeve deafra elef vachamesh mea ammin. levatar tehoma rabba hava salik bachashocha vachashocha chafe kolla. ad denafak nehora (leel 15 1) uvaka bachashocha venafak veitnehir dichtiv, (Iyov 12:22) megalle amukot minni choshech vayyotze laor tzalmavet.

Maya itkalu betikla elef vachamesh mea beetzbean. telat netifu go tikla. palgu minnayyhu lekiyyuma ufalgu dealu letatta. illen salkin veillen nachatin. kevan disliku bisliku deyada. kaim tikla beorach meshar vela sata leyamina velismala. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:12) mi madad beshoolo mayim vegomer.

Kolla hava beh beara satim vela itgalyay. vechela vetakfa umaya gelidin begavvav vela negidu vela itpashtu. ad deanhir alah nehora dilela unehora machat bekuletoy veishteriu chelah. hada hu dichtiv vayyomer elohim yehi or. vayhi or. da hu or kadmaa illaa dehava mikkadmat dena.

Umehacha nafku kol chelin vetukepin. veara itbasmat veappikat chelaha levatar. kevan denahir (venachit) hava istallak nehoreh misyayfe alma ad seyayfe alma. kad istakkal bechayyayve alma itgeniz veittemir vela nafik ella bishviloy setimin dela itgalyayn:

Vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. tenan kol chelma dekayyma bekiyyuma dechi tov shelama hu leela vetatta. chame atvavn kefum archoy kol chad vechad. chama 9 tav leh tav lechelmeh deha orayyta patach beh ki tov. nahir misseyayfe alma lisyayfe alma. 9 tav. tov hu, tav nehiru beashlamuta.

9 Teshiaa decholla. at deitnehir meillaa rishita veitkelil beh veitavid bistimu dinkuda raza dey dehi nekuda chada. 6 mecheleh nafik. beh itavid shamayim. kad istayyaym binkuda chad veitgeniz go, itnahara 2. minneh nafku illaa vetattaa. ilaa temira. tattaa itgalyay beraza ditren. vekayyma bechela dilela.

Veda hu tov. illen telat atvavn tov itkelilu levatar letzaddika dealma dechalil kolla leela vetatta kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov. begin dinhiru illaa kelila beh dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:9) tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kol maasav. lakkol ketiv da setama demilla begin leanhara yoma chad denahir lecholla. illaa al kolla. ad kan setama demillin.

Bereshit bara elohim. raza dereshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma. da chachma illaa deihi reshit. 2 beta dealma leitshakkaa mehahu nahar deayyil beh. raza dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. venahar deachnish kolla meumeka illaa vela pesiku memoy lealmin leashkaa leginta.

Vehahu imka illaa bayit rishon bereshit istayymu beh atvavn bechad shevil dakkik deganiz begavveh. umiggo hahu umeka nafku teren chelin dichtiv et hashshamayim. shamayim la ketiv ella hashshamayim. miggo hahu umeka desatim mikkolla. veet haaretz setima da appik lehay aretz.

Aval bichlala deshamayim hava. unefaku kechada mitdabbeka besitroy da beda. kad itnehir reshita decholla, shamayim natlu lah veotivu lah beatrah, dichtiv veet haaretz. veet mikkelala deatvavn deinnun et.
Kad ithadderat ara lemetav beatrah veitperash
60: Missitroy deshamayim, havat toha uvoha leitdabbeka bashshamayim kechada (nusach acher kekadmita) bekadmita. begin dechamat lashshamayim nehirin vehi itchashchat. ad dinhora illaa nafak alah veanhir lah vetavat beatrah leistakkela bishmaya appin beappin. ucheden ittakkanat ara veitbasmat.

Nafak nehora bistar yamina (leel 17) vachashocha bistar semala. veafrish lon levatar begin leitkallela da beda. hada hu dichtiv vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech. vei tema hava havedala mammash. la. ella yom ate missitra dinhora deihu yamina. velayla missitra dechashocha deihu semala. vechad nafku kechada afrish lon. vehavedala hava missitroy leistakkela appin beappin uleitdabbeka da beda lemehevo kolla chad.

Veihu ikre yom vekare leh yom. veihi kare layla kema deat amer vayyikra elohim laor yom vegomer. mahu velachoshech. da choshech deachid lelayla delet lah nehora miggarmah (sefer acher vehi itkere layla dichtiv velachoshech kera layla begin deachid bah choshech velet la nehora miggarmah) veaf al gav deata missitra deesha deihi choshech. aval choshech ad deitnehir missitra deyom, yom nahir lelayla, velayla la nahir ad zimna dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:12) velayla kayyom yair kachashecha kaora.

Ribbi elazar kafatz bekadmita vedarash (sham 29) kol Adonai al hammayim el hakkavod hirim Adonai al mayim rabbim. kol Adonai da kol illaa dimmanna al hammayim denagdin middarga ledarga ad demitkanshe leatar chad bichnufeya chada. hahu kol illaa meshadder leinnun mayin bearchayyhu kol chad vechad kefum archeh. kehay genana dimmanna al maya leshaddar lon lechol atar vaatar kidchaze leh. kach kol Adonai memanna al maya.

El hakkavod hirim kema deat amer, (Iyov 26:14) veraam gevurotav mi yitbonen. da sitra deatya min gevura venafka minneh. davar acher el hakkavod hirim da yamina denafka minneh semala. Adonai al mayim rabbim. Adonai da chachma illaa deikre yod (eden dekayyeyma) al mayim rabbim al hahu umeka setimaa denafik minneh kema deat amer (Tehillim 77:20) ushevilcha bemayim rabbim.

Ribbi shimon parish pelugeta veamar. patach kera veamar ketiv, (Shemot 25:27) leummat hammisgeret tihyena hattabbaot battim levaddim. man hahu misgeret, da hu atar sagir dela peticha bar bishvil chad dakkik deityeyda bignizu legabbeh. uvegineh itmele verashim tarin leadlaka botzinin. uvegin deihu atar ganiz vesatim ikre misgeret veda hu alma deate. vehahu alma deate itkere misgeret.

Tihyena hattabbaot illen izkan illain deitachadan da veda maya merucha verucha meesha veesha mimmayya. kulhon itachadan da beda venafkan da min da behane (sefer acher kohane) izkan, vechulhon mistakkelan legabbe hahu misgeret. deveh mitached lehahu nahara illaa leashkaa lon veitachadan beh.

Battim levaddim. hane izkan melein (illain) innun battim veatrin levaddim deinnun retichin diltatta. begin dada ate missitra deesha. veda missitra demaya. veda missitra derucha vechen kulhu begin lemeheve reticha laarona. veal da man demikrav yikrav beillen baddim vela bamme dilgav. lech lech amrin nezira, sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav. bar innun deitchazzun leshammasha legav. lon ityehiv reshuta leaalaa leshammasha ulekarava. veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 1:nusach acher) vehazzar hakkarev yumat.

Bet divreshit ravreva. ribbi yose shail leh. veamar hay shitta yome bereshit deka taninan man innun. amar leh hayeynu dichtiv (Tehillim 104:16) arze levanon asher nata. kema deillen arazin nafkin min levanon. hachi name innun shitta yomin nafkin min bereshit.

Veillen shitta yomin illain kera parish lon dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedula vehaggevura vehattiferet vegomer. ki chol da tzaddik. bashshamayim da tiferet. uvaaretz da keneset yisrael. ketargumo di achid bishmaya uveara. kelomar disoda dealma deikre kol, ihu achid betiferet deikre shamayim, uvaartz
61: Veal da berishit, 2 reshit hi (chachma, kema dateragem yonatan Bereshit bechachmeta) begin deihi tinyayna lechushebna veikre reshit. begin dehay kitra illaa temira hi kadmaa. veal dela ayil bechushebna, tinyayna have rishit. begin da 2 reshit. veod kema dechachma illaa ihi reshit. chachma tattaa reshit name haveya. veal da let leafrasha 2 min reshit.
Bereshit maamar karinan leh vehachi hu. veshitta yomin nafkin minah veitkelilan beh. veillen ikrun kegavvna deillen ochoranin.

Bara elohim. hada hu dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. may lehashekot et haggan leashkaa ulekayyma leh uleistakkela beh bechol ma deitzterich. elohim elohim chayyim, demashma bereshit bara elohim vadday al yeda dehahu nahara begin leappaka kolla uleashkaa kolla.

Et hashshamayim chibbura dechar venukeva kedka chaze. levatar hay. beh itbere alma letatta. beh yahiv chela lecholla. et hashshamayim demashma deshamayim appiku et bechela deraza deelohim chayyim batar dereshit appik leh.

Kevan dehay appik kolla vecholla ityeyshav beducheteh kechad. izka da batrayyta itavidat reshit. uvehay reshit appik nehorin ilain veshare nahara veshare maya lenagda lekabbela letatta. veal da bereshit vadday bara elohim. beh bara alma tattaa. beh appik nehorin. beh yahiv chela lecholla.
Ribbi yehuda amar al da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 10:15) hayitpaer haggarzen al hachotzev bo. shevacha deman, lav deumana hu. kach behay reshit bara elohim illaa et hashshamayim. shevacha deman deelohim hu.

Amar ribbi yose hay dichtiv, (Devarim 4:7) asher lo elohim kerovim elav. kerovim. karov mibbae leh. ella elohim illaa. elohim defachad yitzchak. elohim batraa. uvegine kach kerovim (lekamman kalla 1) ugevurot saggiin innun denafkin mechad vechulhu chad.

Tosefta bereshitt bara remez lechetter chachma. elohim romez levina. ett romez ligdula ugevura. hashamayim da hu tippeerett. vett romez lenetztzach hod yesod. haaretz romez lemalchutt: (74 kan tosefta)

Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or. (vayyomer elohim lemi hu omer eno omer ella laacherim. yehe 0 or leolam hazze. vayhi or leolam habba). veda (da) ihu nehora devara kudesha berich hu bekadmita. vehu nehora deena. vehu nehora deachaze kudesha berich hu leadam kadmaa vehave chaze beh misyayfe alma vead seyayfe alma. vehu nehora deachaze kudesha berich hu ledavid vehava meshabbeach veamar (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha. vehu nehora deachaze kudesha berich hu lemoshe vechama beh miggilad vead dan.

Uveshaata dechama kudesha berich hu dikumun telata darin chayyayvin. veinnun dara deenosh vedara detofana vedara defallaga (nusach acher ganiz leh) begin dela yishtammeshun beh, veyahav yateh kudesha berich hu lemoshe veishtammash beh telat yerachin deishtaarun leh miyyome ibbura dileh. kema deat amer, (Shemot 2:2) vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim.

Uvatar telat yerachin al kamme paro natil leh kudesha berich hu minneh. ad dekaim al tura desinay lekabbala orayyta vehadar leh hahu nehora veishtammash beh kol yomoy. velo yachlu bene yisrael lemikrav bahadeh ad deyahav masve al anpoy kema deat amer, (Shemot la) vayyiru miggeshet elav. veitattaf beh ketallit. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:2) ote or kassalma.

Yehi or vayhi or. kol ma deittemar beh vayhi hu bealma den uvealma deate. amar ribbi yitzchak or devara kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit hava salik nehoreh misseyayfe alma ad seyayfe alma veitgeniz.
May tama itgeniz. begin dela yithannun minneh chayyayve alma. vealmin la yithannun beginehon. vehu tamir letzaddikayya, latztzaddik dayka
62: Dichtiv, (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzaddik uleyishre lev simcha ucheden yitbassemun almin vihon kolla chad. vead yoma deyhe alma deate hu tamir veganiz.

Hahu nehora nafak miggo chashocha deitgallefa bekilfoy ditmira decholla. ad demehahu nehora deitgeniz itgelif bishvil chad temira lachashocha diltatta unehora share beh. man chashocha diltatta. hahu deikre layla dichtiv beh velachoshech kara layla.

Veal da taninan may dichtiv, (Iyov 12:22) megalle amukot minni choshech. ribbi yose omer i tema mechoshech satim itgalleyayn. ha chazinan ditmirin innun kol innun kitrin illain vekarinan amukot. mahu megalle. ella kol innun temirin illain la itgalleyayn ella miggo hahu chashocha deihu beraza delelya. (vihe kolla chad beraza davehayh or hallevana keor hachamma bedarga chada vead yoma deyete hu ganuz vetamir 1) ta chaze, kol innun amikin setimin denafke miggo machashava vekala natil lon la itgalleyayn ad demilla megalla lon. man milla hayeynu dibbur.

Vehay dibbur ikre shabbat. uvegin deshabbat ikre dibbur, dibbur dechol asur beshabbat. (gillayon 547 vechach hava avid rabbi shimon kad chame leimeh dahavat mashetaaya hava amar la, imma, shetuke, shabbat hu veasir). begin dedibbur da baaya leshaltaa vela ochora. vehay dibbur deihu ate missitra dechoshech megalle amukot miggavveh. umashma minni choshech. hahu deate missitra dechoshech dichtiv minni dayyka.

Amar ribbi yitzchak i hachi may dichtiv vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech. amar leh, or appik yom vechoshech appik layla. levatar chavar lon kechada vehavu chad dichtiv vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad. delayla veyom ikrun chad. vehay dichtiv vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech (deafrish machloket) da bezimna degaluta deishtechach paroda.

Amar ribbi yitzchak ad hacha dechura beor venukeva bachashocha. levatar mitchabberan kechada lemehve chad. bemay itparshan leishtemoda ben nehora uven chashocha. mitparshan dargin vetarvavyyhu kechad havu. deha let nehora ella bachashocha velet chashocha ella binhora. veaf al gav deinnun chad itparshan bigvavnin veim kol da innun chad dichtiv yom echad.

Ribbi shimon amar al berit alma itbere veitkayyaym dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vearetz lo samti. man berit da tzaddik yesoda dealma deihu raza dezachur. veal da alma kayyma bivrit yomam valayla kechada dichtiv im lo veriti yomam velayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. chukkot shamayim denagdin venafkin meeden illaa.

Patach veamar, (Shoftim Adonai:11) mikkol mechatztzim ben mashabbim sham yetannu tzidkot Adonai vegomer. mikkol mechatztzim da kol yaakov. mechatztzim kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 17:4) ish habbenayim. ben mashabbim deihu yativ ben innun deshaavin mayya milleela vehu natil bitren sitrin vechalil lehon begavveh.

Sham yetannu tzidkot Adonai. tamman hu atar mehemnuta leitdabbaka. sham yetannu tzidkot Adonai. tamman yankin tzidkot Adonai veshaavin. tzidkot pirzono (beyisrael) da tzaddik dealma deihu kayyaym vekadish, veihu shaiv venatil kolla umefazzer legabbe yamma rabba innun mayin illain. beyisrael, deyisrael yartu kayyaym da. veyahaveh lon kudesha berich hu yerutat almin.

Kevan deyisrael shavku leh dehavu gazrin vela parin. ma ketiv, (Shoftim Adonai:11) az yardu lashshearim am Adonai. yardu lashshearim, innun shaare tzedek havu yatvin letare vela alin lego. uvehahu zimna
63: Ketiv, (Shoftim 2) vayyazevu bene yisrael et Adonai vegomer. ad deatat devora unedivat lon behay kema dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:2) bifroa peraot beyisrael vegomer.

Veal da ketiv chadlu perazon beyisrael. chadlu perazon, da hu pirzono deka amaran. chadlu perazon, kayyaym kaddisha dela itparun. (Shoftim Adonai:7) ad shakkamti devora shakkamti em beyisrael. may em. ella ana nechatit mayin illain meela lekayyeyma almin, beyisrael setam leela vetatta, leachazaa dealma la itkayyaym ella al keyayma da. veraza dechola (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam ketiv, (lecha lecha oz amud alef).

Telat nafke mechad. chad bitlat kayyma al ben teren. teren yankin lechad, chad yanik lechamma sitrin. keden kolla chad. hada hu dichtiv vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad yom deerev vavoker kalil kechada. hayenu raza divrit yomam valayla uveh kolla chad:

Tosefta taninan mal vlo para ett hammila keilu lo mal. begin ditteren dargin innun mila upperia. zachor vshamor. tzaddik vtztzedek. dechar vnukeva. ott beritt da yosef uveritt da rachel. vitztzetricha lechabbera lon. uvemma mechabber lon. kad ihu gazir upparia. uman degazir velo paria keillu avdu benayyhu piruda, (74 kan tosefta)

Vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim. ribbi yehuda amar shiva rekiim innun leela. vechulhu kayyma bikdushatta illaa. ushema kaddisha behu ishtachlal. veda rakia hu beemtzaut maya.

Da rakia kayyma al gabbe chevavta ochoranin. veihu afrish ben mayin illain lemayyin tattain. umayin tattain karin leillain. umehay rakia shatan lon. da hu demafrish benayyhu. begin dechulhu maya beh kelilan. ulevatar nachit lon lehani chevavta veshaavin mittamman.

Ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:12) gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum. gan naul, decholla astim beh. decholla itkelil beh. gal naul, dehahu nahar nagid venafik veayyil beh vechalil vela appik vekarshe maya beh vekayyme. may tama begin deruach tzafon nashiv beinnun maya veitkerishu vela nafke levar ad deitavid k1roch (leel 29 2) veilmale sitra dedarom deakish tukpeh dehay kerach la nafke minneh mayya lealmin.

Vechezu dehahu rekia illaa kechezu dehay kerach demitkarsha umachnis begaveh kol innun mayin. kach hahu illaa dealeh kanish kol innun mayin veafrish ben mayin ilain lemayin tattain. vehay deamaran yehi rakia betoch hammayim. bimtziut. lav hachi. ella yehi ketiv. hahu dehave minneh bimtziut maya have. veihu leel dekayyma al resha dechevavta.

Amar ribbi yitzchak it keruma bimtziut meoy devar nash deihu pasik mittatta leela veshaiv meela veyahiv letatta. kach gavvna da rakia ihu beemtzaita vekayma al innun chevata diltatta. veihu parish ben mayin ilain letattain. ta chaze, innun mayin aadu veolidu chashocha. veal raza da ketiv, (Shemot 26:33) vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim.
Ribbi abba patach (Tehillim 104:3) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav vegomer bamayim illen mayin illain decholla debhu takkin beta kema deat amer, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit uvitvuna yitkonan.

Hassam avim rechuvo. ribbi yesa sava palig avim amud bet yam. av deihu choshech semala dekayyma al yam da. hamehallech al kanfe ruach da rucha demakdesha illaa. veraza da (Shemot 25:18) shenayim keruvim zahav. ketiv (Tehillim 18:11) vayyirkav al keruv vayyaof vayyede al kanfe ruach. vayyirkav al keruv chad levatar igle al kanfe ruach vead dehay itar la itgeli behay.

Ribbi yose amar ketiv, (Iyov 28:25) umayim tikken bammidda. bammidda mammash atkin lehu kad matun legavvav. veinnun tikkuna dealma kad matu missitra digvura. amar ribbi abba kach havu kadmae amre kad havu matan lehay atar merachashan shifvavn dechakkimin vela amarin middi begin dela yitanshun.
Ribbi elazar amar at kadmaa deatvavn hava shatya al anpoy dekitra dachya veitattar millera milleela vesalik
64: Venachit umaya mitgallefe begillufayyhu umityayshvan beduchetayyhu veitkelilu chad bechad. vechen atvavn kulhu kelilan da beda umitatteran da beda ad deitbene alayyhu binyayna visoda.

Vechad itbeniu kulhu veitatteru. havu mayin illain mitarvin bemayin tattain vaafiku beta dealma (veal da appiku teren nehorin chad deikre eretz unehora deikre shamayim) veal da 2 itchazze berisha umayin salkin venachatin ad dehay rakia hava veafrish lon. umachloket hava bashsheni deveh itbere gehinnom deihu nura dedalik kema deat amer, (Devarim 4:24) esh ochla hu. vezammin leashraa al reshayyhu dechayyayvaya.

Amar ribbi yehuda mehacha kol machloket deihu leshem shamayim sofah lehitkayyem. deha hacha machloket deihu leshem shamayim hava veshamayim behay itkayyaym. levatar da dichtiv vayyikra elohim larakia shamayim vegomer. bekatfira deilita bekistayyhu shechiche veitkayymu. deha taninan ketiv, (Shemot 26:33) vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim dayyka, deha ihu rakia dimfaresh bego beemtzaita.

Ta chaze, ketiv levatar yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad. mittachat hashshamayim mammash. el makom echad. leatar deikre echad. veihu yam tattaa deha ihu ashlim leechad. uvella ihu la ikre echad. umashma dichtiv yikkavu deveh mitkanshin kulhu maya kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vegomer.

Ribbi yesa amar el makom echad, da ihu atar dichtiv beh (Yeshayahu 54:10) uverit shelomi lo tamut. deha ihu natil kolla veshade beyamma uveh ittakkanat ara dichtiv veterae hayyabbasha da hu eretz. kema deat amer vayyikra elohim layyabbasha aretz.

Ammay ikre yabbasha. amar ribbi yitzchak hayeynu dichtiv (Devarim 16:3) lechem oni lechem ani ketiv. uvegin deihu lechem ani ikre yabbasha. veshaiv begavvav kol memin dealma veihi yevesha have. ad deatar da imle lah ucheden nagdin maya orach deinnun mekorot.

Ulemikve hammayim kara yammim da hu bet kenishut mayin dilela detamman mitkanshin kol maya umittamman nagdin venafkin. amar ribbi chiyyay mikkeve hamayim da tzaddik. dechad mata lemikve hammayim ketiv vayyar elohim ki tov uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov. (vechen or kadmaa tov ikre. vechen kullehu ketiv behu ki tov. bar yoma tinyayna dela ketiv beh ki tov). ribbi yose amar yisrael mikve ihu. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:13) mikve yisrael Adonai.

Ribbi chiyyay amar da tzaddik. hayenu dichtiv kara yammim. begin dinchalin vmabbuin uneharin kulhu natil lon veihu mekora decholla veihu natil kolla begine kach yammim. veal da vayyar elohim ki tov uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov.

Uvegin deitreshim ihu afrish ben yoma kadmaa litlitaa vela ittemar ki tov begavayyhu. deha beyoma telitaa avdat ara ivin mechela dehay tzaddik. dichtiv vayyomer elohim tadshe haaretz deshe esev mazria zera etz peri. may etz peri. da etz haddaat tov vara deihu avid ibbin uferin. ose peri da tzaddik yesod dealma.

Lemino dechol bene nesha deit lon rucha kaddisha. deihu ibba dehahu ilana rashim behu reshima lemino. umay ihu, berit kodesh berit shalom. uvene mehemnuta lemino, lemino alin vela mitparshan minnih. vetzaddik ose peri hu. vehahu ilana itavrat veappikat hahu peri lemino. lemino dehahu ose peri deyehve kavvavteh.

Zakkaa chulakeh man dedame leimmeh velavoy. veal ken reshima kaddisha beyoma teminaa begin deyidme leimmeh. (begin dehi darga teminaa vehahi nafsha defarach mane itzterichat leitchazaa kama litmanya yomin) vechad itperaat veitgalyay reshima kaddisha begin deyidme leavoy. veal da etz peri da imma. ose peri da berit kodesh avoy. lemino deyidme leh veitreshim beh.

Asher zaro vo al haaretz. zaro vo. zera bo mibbae leh. may zaro vo. ella zera vav bo. al haaretz hachi hu vadday. deha hahu zara ashde al ara. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael deinnun kaddishin vedamyayn lekaddishin. veal da vadday ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim. kullam tzaddikim vadday. deha mehane nafku ulehane damyayn. zakkain innun bealma den uvealma deate.
65: Amar ribbi chiyyay ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:12 veno) ose eretz bechocho. may ose eretz (bechocho. asa eretz mibbae leh. ella ose vadday tadir umetakken kudesha berich hu lehay eretz) da kudesha berich hu leela. bechocho da tzaddik. mechin tevel bechachmato. tevel da eretz diltatta. bechachmato da tzedek dichtiv vehu (Tehillim 9:9) yishpot tevel betzedek. ose eretz da kudesha berich hu, dehu matkin ara umatkin archoy. uvemma. bechocho kidkaamaran.
Ribbi yehuda amar beatvavn gelifan deribbi elazar it kutere deatvavn 22 ketirin kechada. teren atvavn da salik veda nachit udesalik nachit udenachit salik. vesiman da (yeshaya ma) ach bach el.

Ribbi yose amar tifsa deshikla beemtzaita kayyma. vesiman (Vayikra 19:35) bemidda bemishkal vegomer. mishkal lishan dekayyma beemtzaita. veraza da (Shemot 30:13) shekel hakkodesh ketiv. umoznayim beh kayyman veitkalu. man moznayim kema deat amer, (Vayikra 19:36) mozne tzedek. vechulhu kayymin bemishkal beshekel hakkodesh. ribbi yehuda amar beshekel hakkodesh da ruach hakkodesh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak ketiv, (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam. bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu. illen shemaya diltatta deitavidu bidvar shamayim dilela. beruach. deappik kala ad demate lehahu nahar denagid venafik vela paskin memoy lealmin. uveruach piv kol tzevaam. kulhu tattae kayymin beruach deihu dechar.

(Tehillim 104:13) mashke harim mealiyyotav mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz. mashke harim mealiyyotav. man aliyyotav kidkaamaran. dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:13) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav. mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz. raza dehahu nahar denagid venafik letatta hada hu dichtiv ose peri asher zaro vo vegomer veha ittemar:

Yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz. yehi meorot chaser. ribbi chizkiyya omer meorot desharya beh tukefa dedina. kilta dedina. ribbi yose amar yehi meorot letatta ihi sihara devah talya askara leravye alma. uvah talya meorot. begin deihi nehora zutera mikkol nehorin. vezimnin deitchashshecha vela mekabbela nehora.

Birkia hashshamayim. da hu rekia deihu kelala dechulhu. begin denatil kol nehorin vehu nahir lehay nehora dela nahara (vehi talya beh begin deitdabbak bah hahu meera uveh talyayn letatta kol innun zayynin acharanin begin zaayrev dinhora).

Ribbi yitzchak amar veappik (nusach acher vaafillu) hay rekia dela nahir. vekarinan leh malchut shamayim veeretz yisrael veeretz hachayyim. hashshamayim ihu (denahir) hay rakia. begine kach yehi meorot chaser 6. may tama deha bela vav mota hu bealma.

Yehi meorot kolla beh talya leachlala lilit bealma. ketiv, (Iyov 3:19) katan vegadol sham hu. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 33:21) ki im sham addir Adonai lanu. veal da ketiv, (yeshaya 34:14) ach sham hirgia lilit umatza lah manoach.

Ribbi elazar amar yehi meorot. aspaklaryaa dela nahara migarmah. ella al yeda dinhorin illain denaharin lah kaashashita delakta nehora denahir. ketiv, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz. hinne aron da aspaklaryaa dela nahara. habberit aspaklaryaa denahara. hinne aron da hi meorot. aron tevuta leaalaa begavay tora shebbichtav. habberit da shimsha denahir lah. veihi berit bahadeh aron habberit dayyka. adon kol haaretz. habberit deihu adon kol haaretz.
Uvegin dehay aron ihu adon. begin shimsha denahir lah venahir lechol alma. hachi itkere
66: Uminneh nakta shema. veitkere hay aron adon beraza dealef dalet nun yod. kema deamrinan tzaddik vetzedek kach adon 65 da veda talyayn.

Ta chaze, kochavim umazzalot bivrit kayyaymin deihu (shimsha dekaamaran veda) rekia hashshamayim dirshimin beh ugelifin beh kochavim umazzalot uveh talyayn leanhara. ribbi yesa sava hava amar hachi yehi meorot detalyay birkia hashshamayim veda sihara detalyay beh. kevan dichtiv vehayu limorot ha shimsha (kan chaser) ulemoadim deha zimnayay vechaggin yerachin veshabbatte behu talyan vehavu.

Vecholla baavidta kadmaa illaa. dishmeh kaddisha itachid beh. veihu hu kolla. shiva kochve innun lokovel shiva rekiin vechulhu maddevre alma. vealma illaa alayyhu. uteren almin ninhu alma illaa vealma tattaa. tattaa kegavvna dilela dichtiv, (dibba hayamim 1 16) min haolam vead haolam. melech illaa. umelech tattaa.

(Tanenan) ketiv Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed. Adonai melech leela. Adonai malach beemtzaita. Adonai yimloch letatta. ribbi acha amar Adonai (nusach acher da chachma ilaa) melech da alma illaa deihu alma deate. Adonai malach da tiferet yisrael. Adonai yimloch da aron habberit (nusach acher rabbi acha ameraz Adonai melech da chachma illaa. Adonai melech da alma illaa deate. Adonai yimloch da tiferet yisrael).

Ata zimna ochora david veahadar lon mittatta leela. veamar (Tehillim 10:16) Adonai melech olam vaed. Adonai melech letatta. olam beemtzaita. vaed leela. detamman viuda vekiyyuma veashlemuta decholla. melech leela yimloch letatta.

Ribbi abba amar kol hane meorot kulhu mitchabberan birkia hashshamayim. lehair al haaretz leanhara al ara. man hu rekia denahir al ara. hve ema da nahar denagid venafik meeden dichtiv venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan.

Ta chaze, kevan desihara shalta veitnehir mehahu nahara denagid venafik. kol innun shemaya diltatta vechelehon kulhon ittosfan nehora. vechochvaya dimmannan al ara kulhu shaltin umegaddelin tzemachim veilanin. vealma itrabbe bechulhu. veafillu maya venune yamma kulhu birvu yattir. vechamma gardini nimusin shatan bealma. begin dechulhu bechedva birvu chela. kad chedva hu beve malka afilu innun mibbe tare. veafilu innun middeve tarnashe (nusach acher taretashey). kulhu chadan veshatan bealma. veravye dealma baayayn leistammera.
