Ribbi acha amar. vayyiten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim. vechad kulhon kayyaymin beh keden chedvavta da im da, keden sihara azirat nehora mikkamme shimsha. kol ma denatil begin leanhara lah hada hu dichtiv lehair al haaretz.

Rav yitzchak amar ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim. man shivat hayyamim. illen innun shivat yomin divreshit. ribbi yehuda amar illen innun shivat yeme hammilluim.

Milluim vadday. begin dehahu zimna itbassam alma veithaddar beashlamuteh vela itpegim sihara begin chivya bisha dichtiv beh (Mishlei 16:28) venargan mafrid alluf. veematay yehe da bezimna dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach. ucheden ketiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad:

Yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya leminah. amar ribbi elazar illen mayin tattain derachashin zayynin kegavvna dilela. innun illae veinnun tattae. ribbi chiyyay amar illae appiku nefesh chayya. umay nihu. da nefesh deadam kadmaa kema deat amer vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya.

Veof yeofef al haaretz illen sheliche illain deitchazzun livne nasha bechezu devar nash. mashma dichtiv yeofef al haaretz. begin deit ochoranin dela itchazzun ela berucha mammash lefum suchletanu divni nesha.
67: Begine chach la ketiv beillen leminehu keinnun ochoranin dichtiv behu veet kol of kanaf leminehu, begin deillen la meshanyayn mimminayyhu lealmin kehane ochoranin dela ketiv behu leminehu. vei tema it behu dimshanyayn da min da. hachi hu vadday deha it behu dimshanyayn ellin meillen begine chach ketiv umishsham yippared:

Vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim. illen livyatan uvat zugo. et kol nefesh hachayya haromeset. da nefesh dehahi chayya deihi romeset led sitre alma. uman ihi chayya deihi romeset. hve ema da lilit.

Asher shartzu hammayim leminehem. demayin megaddelin lon. dechad ate sitra dedarom sharan mayin venagdin lechol sitrin vearbe yamma azlin veavrin kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:26) sham oniyyot yehallechun livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo.

Veet kol of kanaf leminehu. kema deat amer (Kohelet 10:20) ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol uvaal kenafayim yaggid davar. ribbi yose amar kulhon mishshit gadfin vela meshanyayn lealmin. uvegine chach ketiv leminehu. may leminehu. lezayyna dilela. veillen tasan veshatan alma beshit vechaman ovadin divni nesha vesalkin lon leela. veal da ketiv, (Kohelet 10:20) gam bemaddaacha melech al tekallel vegomer.

Ribbi chizkiyya amar haromeset, hashshoretzet mibbae leh. ella kidamrinan ramash lelya. veal da (Tehillim 104:20) bo tirmos kol chayto yaar. dechulhu shaltan beshaata deihi shalta. ufatchin shirata bitlat sitrin defalgu lelya. vezamre shirata vela mishtakkeche. veal illen ketiv, (Yeshayahu 62:6) hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem.

Rabbi shimon kam veamar mistakkel havena, dechad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre adam, izdazeu kol illain vetattain. veyoma shetitaa hava salik bedargoy ad desalka reuta illaa venahir sheruta dechol nehorin.

Ufetach tara demizrach deha mittamman nehora nafik. vedarom achame tokfe dinhora deyarit merisha veittakkaf bemizrach. mizrach atkif letzafon vetzafon itar veitpashat vekare vechayil sagge lemaarav lemikrav uleishtattafa bahadeh. keden maarav salka betzafon veitkkashshar beh. levatar darom atya veachid bemaarav. vesacharin leh darom vetzafon deazlin gidre ginta. keden mizrach kariv bemaarav umaarav sharya bechedva uvaat mikkulhu veamar naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu. dilhve kegavvna da bearba sitrin veela vetatta. umizrach itdabbak bemaarav veappik leh. veal da taninan adam meatar devet hammikdash nafak.

Tu naase adam. kudesha berich hu amar leillen tattae deatu missitra dilela. raza dishma da desalik adam. adam meraza setima illaa. adam raza deatvavn. deha adam kalil leela vechalil letatta. adam echad leela leela. 40 setima deihi 40 millemrbe hammisra. 4 tattaa distima bemaarav. veda kelala dilela vetatta. ittakkan leela ittakkan letatta.
Ilen atvavn kad nachata letatta kulhu kechada beashlamuteh ishtechach dechar venukeva. venukeva besitroy itdabbekat. ad deappil iluye shinta udemuch. vehava rame beatar deve makdesha letatta.

Unesar leh kudesha berich hu vetakkin la kema dimtaknin lechalla veaala leh. hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav vayyisgor basar tachtenna. vayyikkach achat dayyka. besifre kadmai ashkachna (Vayikra 19 amud alef) da lilit kadmita dehavat immeh veitabberat minneh

Vela havat lekivleh ezer kema dichtiv uleadam lo matza ezri kenegdo. may ezri semech. ad hahi shaata dichtiv lo tov hyot haadam levaddo eese lo ezer kenegdo. ta chaze adam batraa decholla hava. hachi itchazze lemete al alma shelim.
Tu amar rabbi shimon ketiv vekol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz vechol esev hassade terem yitzmach ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz vegomer. vechol siach hassade illen
68: Ilanin ravrevin lintiu levatar vehavu zehirin.

Ta chaze, adam vechavva da besitra deda itberiu. may tama la itberiu anpin beanpin. begin dichtiv ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz vezivuga la ishtechach betikkunih kedka yeut. vechad ittakanu hay diltatta veithaddaru anpin beanpin keden ishtechach leela.

Menalan min hammishkan dichtiv, (Shemot 40:17) hukam hammishkan begin demishkan ochora ittakam immeh. vead la ittakam letatta la ittakam leela. uf hacha kad ittakam letatta ittakam leela. uvegin dead kean la ittakan leela la itberiu anpin beanpin. ukera ochach dichtiv ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz. uvegine chach veadam ayin dela hava betikkuneh.

Vechad ishtallimat chavva ishtelim adam. vekodem lachen la ishtelim. veraza da dead kean la it at samech befarshata. veaf al gav dechavrayay amru. aval samech da ezer. veda ezri dilela deithaddar leela anpin beanpin dechar venukeva. istammach da lokovel da vadday. (Tehillim 111:8) semuchim laad leolam asuyim beemet veyashar. semuchim, da dechar venukeva deinnun semuchim kechada (nusach acher deinnun semuchim olam tattaa baolam illaa dead lo ittakkan olam tattaa lo ittakkan hahu olam dekaamaran) (hay olam deka amaran talya baolam diltatta vechad lo ittakkan olam diltatta lo ittakkan hahu olam deka amaran).

Ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz. deha da beda samich. olam da tattaa kad ittakkan veithadderu anpin beanpin veittakanu ishtechach samech leela. deha mikkadmat dena la hava ovada betikkuna (nusach acher olam bateykevaneyh) begin dela himtir Adonai elohim al haaretz veda beda talyay.

Ma ketiv batreh veed yaale min haaretz da tikkuna diltatta levatar vehishka et kol pene haadama. veed yaale min haaretz da tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura. davar acher may tama lo himtir begin dela ishtechach tikkuna deyaale min haaretz. veal da min ara tattaa itar ovada leela.

Ta chaze, tenana salik min ara bekadmita. veanana itar. vecholla itchabbar levatar da beda. kegavvna da tenana dekarbana itar mittatta veavid shelimu leela veitchabbar kolla da beda veishtallimu kegavvna da leela. itaruta share mittatta ulevatar ishtelim kolla. veilmale dichneset yisrael sharya beitaruta bekadmita, la itar lekivlah hahu dilela. uvetiuveta diltatta ishtelim leela.

Rabbi abba amar ammay ketiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan veetz haddaat tov vara. etz hachayyim ha taninan demahalach chamesh mea shenin hava. vechol memoy divreshit mitpalgin techotoy. etz hachayyim bimtziut deginta mammash vehu natil kol memoy devreshit umitpallegin techotoy.

Deha hahu nahar denagid venafik hu sharya al hahu ginta veayyil beh umittaman mitpallegin maya lechamma sitrin. venatil kola hahi ginta. ulevatar nafke minnah umitpallegin lechamma nachalin letatta kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday. kema denafkin mehahu alma illaa veashke leinnun turin illain deafarsemona dachya. levatar kad matan leetz hachayyim mitpallegin techotoy bechol setar kefum archoy.

Veetz haddaat tov vara ammay ikre hachi. deha etz da lav ihu beemtzaita. aval etz haddaat tov vara may hu. ella begin deyanka mitteren sitrin veyada lon keman deyanik mitka umerira. uvegin deyanka mitteren sitrin veyada lon vesharya begavavyyhu ikre hachi tov vara. vechol innun netiin sharyayn alayyhu.

Uveh achidan netiin ochoranin illain veinnun ikrun arze levanon. man innun (leel lo 1) arze levanon. innun shit yomin illain sheshet yeme vereshit dekaamaran. arze levanon asher nata. netiot vadday deitkayymu levatar.
Mikkan ulehala samech may hi vayyisgor basar tachtenna. besitroy hava. vehava da besitroy deda. vadday akaran kudesha berich hu veshatil
69: Lon beatar ochora veithadderu anpin beanpin lekiyyuma. kegavvna da semichan almin. akaran kudesha berich hu veshatil lon beatar ochora veitkayyeymu bekiyyuma shelim.

Veamar rabbi abba menalan deadam vechavva netiin havu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) netzer mataay maase yaday lehitpaer. maase yaday dayyka. dela ishtaddelu behon biryayn ochoranin. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 17:11) beyom nitech tesagsegi divhahu yoma deitnetau bealma sarchu.

Tenan hannetiot kekarne chagavim havu unehora dilhon dakkik vela havu naharin. kevan deitnetau veittakkenu. itrabbiu binhora veikrun arze levanon. veadam vechavva ad deitnetau la itrabbiu binhora vela seliku recha vadday. itakkaru veishtilu veittakanu kedka yaot:

Vaytzav Adonai elohim. ha taninan let tzav ella avoda zara. Adonai zo birkat hashshem. elohim ellu haddayyaynin. al haadam zo shefichut damim. lemor zo gilluy arayot. mikkol etz haggan velo gezel. achol tochel velo evar min hachay veshappir.

Mikkol etz haggan achol tochel. desharya leh kolla delechlinhu beyichuda. deha chazinan avraham achal, yitzchak veyaakov vechol neviim achalu vechayu. aval ilana da ilana demota ihu (kema dichtiv umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu) man denatil leh bilchodoy mayet. deha samma demota natil (begin deihu mafrish leh min chayyin). veal da ki veyom achalcha mimennu mot tamut begin deka parish netiin.

Rabbi yehuda shail lerabbi shimon, ha ditninan adam harishon moshech bearlato hava, may hu. amar leh deparish berit kodesh meatreh umechulakeh. vadday moshech baarla hava. veshavak berit kodesh vedavak baarla veitpatte bemilla denachash.

Umipperi haetz da itteta. lo tochal mimmennu begin dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavt sheol tzeadeha yitmochu. uvehay have peri, deha beochora la have peri. ki beyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut. begin da ilana demota have kidkaamaran. dichtiv ragleha yordot mavet:

(Vehannachash haya arum mikkol chayyat hassade) rabbi yose amar hay ilana deka amaran hava mitshake milleela veitrabbe vehava chade kema deat amer venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. haggan da itteta. venahar da hava ayil beh veashke leh vehava kolla chad (ucheden Adonai echad ushemo echad). deha mittamman uletatta ihu piruda dichtiv umishsham yippared.

Vehannachash. rabbi yitzchak amar da yetzer hara. rabbi yehuda amar nachash mammash. atu lekammeh derabbi shimon. amar lon vadday kolla chad. vesml hava veitchazze al nachash vetzulemeh. denachash da ihu satan vecholla chad.

Tanina behahi shaata nachat 131 min shemaya rachiv al nachash da vetzulemeh havu chaman kol biryayn vearkan minneh. umeto legabbe itteta bemillin ugerimu mota lealma. vadday bechachma ayyte 131 levavtin al alma vechibbel ilana kadmaa devara kudesha berich hu bealma.

Umilla da have tale al 131 ad deata ilana ochora kaddisha deihu yaakov unetal minneh birchan dela yitbarech 131 leela veesav letatta. deha yaakov dugema deadam harishon hava (veshufereh) deyaakov shufereh deadam harishon hava. veal da kema demana 131 birchan meilana kadmaa. hachi name mana yaakov deihu ilana dugema deadam misml birchan milleela umittatta. veyaakov dideh natil becholla. veal da (Bereshit 32:25) vayyeavek ish immo.

Ketiv vehannachash haya arum da yetzer hara da malach hammavet. uvegin denachash ihu malach hammavet geram mota lechol alma. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar ba lefanay. da hu kitztza dechol bisra denatil nishmeta lechol bisra veikre hachi.
Vayyomer el haishsha af. rabbi yose amar. beaf patach veaf attil bealma. amar lah
70: Leitteta beilana da bera kudesha berich hu alma vadday. ichlu minneh vihyitem kelohim yode tov vara. deha ihu hachi have elohim shemeh etz haddaat tov vara. veal da vihyitem kelohim yode vegomer.

Amar rabbi yehuda la amar hachi. deillu amar beilana da bera kudesha berich hu alma, yaot hava. ki hu kaggarzen beyad hachotzev bo. aval lo amar ella meilana da achal kudesha berich hu ucheden bera alma, vechol uman sani lechavreh, ichlu minneh veattun tehon beran almin. veal da ki yodea elohim ki beyom achalchem mimmennu vegomer uvegin deihu yada da afkid lechu aleh dela techlu minneh.

Amar rabbi yitzchak becholla mallilu shikra. besheruta deamru shikra hava. dichtiv af ki amar elohim lo tochal mikkol etz haggan. velav hachi. deha ketiv mikkol etz haggan achol tochel vechulhu shara leh.

Amar rabbi yose ha taninan depakkid leh kudesha berich hu al avoda zara dichtiv vaytzav. Adonai al birkat hashshem. elohim al haddinin. al haadam al shefichat damim. lemor al gilluy arayot. vechi kamma inshe havu bealma deihu itzterich da. ella vadday kolla al hay ilana hava.

Begin deveh achidan kol illen pikkudin. dechol man denatil leh bilchodoy avid perishu. venatil leh beuchelusin diltatta deachidan beh. venatil avoda zara ushefichut damim vegilluy arayot. avoda zara beinnun ravreve memannan. shefichut damim behay ilana talyayn deihu bistar gevura. usml itpakkad al da. gilluy arayot ishsha hi veinteta ikre. veasir lezamna leinteta bilchudaha ela im baalah dela yehe chashid begilluy arayot. veal da bechulhu itpekad behay ilana. kevan deachal minneh bechulhu avar, deha kolla achid beh.

Rabbi yehuda amar vadday mila da hachi hu. deasir leityachada im inteta bilchudaha ella im ken baalah immah. ma avad hahu rasha. amar ha matiti lehay ilana vela matti uf at keriv umete bidach beh vela temut. umilla da hu osef lah miggarmeh.

Miyyad vattere haishsha ki tov vegomer. bamme chamat. amar rabbi yitzchak hahu ilana (sade) salik rechin kema deat amer, (bareasheytekaz) kereach sade asher beracho Adonai. uvegin hahu reach dehava salik chamadat leh lemechal minneh. rabbi yose amar reiyyay hava. amar leh rabbi yehuda veha ketiv vattippakachna eni shenihem. amar leh hay reiyya beshiura deilana naktat leh (nusach acher shiura delibba havat) dichtiv vattere haishsha dayyka:

Vattere haishsha ki tov. chamat vela chamat. ki tov. chamat ki tov vela ityayshvat beh. ma ketiv levatar vattikkach mippiryo vela ketiv vattikkach mimmennu. vehi itdevakat beatar demota. ugerimat lechol alma mota. veafrishat chayye min mota. uvechova da garim perishuta leafrasha itteta mibbaalah. deha kol middibbur la mitparshan lealmin. uman demafrish kol middibbur itallam vela yachil lemallala. vechevan deishtekal minneh millula ityeyhiv leafra.

Amar rabbi shimon ketiv, (Tehillim 39:3) neelamti dumiyya hechosheti mittov ucheevi nekar. neelamti dumiyya. hay kera keneset yisrael amru begaluta. may tama begin dekol medabbar leh ledibbur. kevan deihi begaluta kol itperash minah umilla la ishtema veal da neelamti dumiyya vegomer. may tama begin dehechosheti mittov dela azil kol bahadah. veyisrael amri (Tehillim 65:2) lecha dumiyya tehilla. may dumiyya, da tehilla ledavid. deihi dumiyya begaluta ushetika bela kol. amar rabbi yitzchak may lecha. begincha ihi dumiyya ushetika deistalleka minnah kol.
Vattikkach mippiryo ha taninan sachata anavim veyahavat leh ugerimu mota lechol alma. deha ilana da beh sharya mota. vehu ilana deshalta belelya.
71: Vechad ihi shalta kol beni alma taamu taama demota. ela innun bene mehemnuta mekadme veyahavu leh nafshayyhu befikdona. uvegin deihu befikdona. ithadderu nafshan leatrayyhu. veal da (Tehillim 92:3) veemunatcha ballelot, ketiv.

Vatippakachna ene shenehem. rabbi chiyyay amar deha itpakkachu leminda bishin dealma ma dela yadu ad hasheta. kevan deyadu veitpakkachu leminda bish. keden yadu ki erumim hem. deavdu zahara illaa dehava chafe alayyhu veistelak minnayyhu. veishtaaru arumim minneh.

Vayyitperu ale teena. itdabbaku leitchafaa beinnun tzulemin dehahu ilana deachalu minneh deikrun tarpe deilana. vayyaasu lahem chagorot. rabbi yose amar kevan deyadu mehay alma veitdabbaku beh. chamu dehay alma mitdabbar al yeda deinnun tarpin deilana. veavadu lehon tukefa leittakfa behu behay alma. ucheden yadu kol zeyayne charshin dealma. uvau lemichgar zayynin beinnun tarpe ilana begin leaggana alayyhu.
Rabbi yehuda amar keden telat alu bedina veitdanu. vealma tattaa itlatyay. vela kayyma bekiyyumeh begin zuhama denachash ad dekayymu yisrael betura desinay.

Levatar albish lon kudesha berich hu bilvushin demishcha ithanni minnayyhu hada hu dichtiv katnot or. bekadmita havu katnot or dehavu mishtammeshin behu beillain dilela. begin demalache illain havu atyayn leithana mehahu nehora. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:6) vattechasserehu meat meelohim vechavod vehadar teatterehu. vehasheta dechavu katnot or. deor ithanne minnayyhu vela nafsha.

Levatar olidu bera kadmaa bera dezuhama hava. teren atu alah dechavva veitabberat minnayyhu veolidat teren. da nafak lezineh veda nafak lezineh. veruach dilhon itparshu, da lesitra da veda lesitra da. da dame lesitroy veda dame lesitroy.

Missitra dekayin kol medorin desitra dezayynin bishin veruchin veshedin vecharashin atyayn. missitra dehevel sitra derachame yattir vela bishlimu. chamar tav bechamar bish. vela ittakkan bahadeh ad deata shet veityaychasu minneh kol innun darin dezakkae alma uveh ishtil alma. umikkayin atyayn kol innun chatzifin ureshaim vechayyayve alma.

Amar rabbi elazar beshaata dechav kayin hava mistefe. begin dechama kammeh zine mashshiryayn mezayynin veatyayn lekatla leh. vechad ahadar bitshuva may kaamar hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama umippanecha essater. may mippanycha essater. ella ehe satir mibbinyayna dili. rabbi abba amar kema deat amer, (Tehillim 22:25) velo histir panav mimmennu (Shemot 3:6) vayyaster moshe panav. veal da umippanecha essater meinnun panim dilach ehe nistar dela yishgechun bi. veal da vehaya kol motzi yahargeni:

Vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot levilti vegomer. may ot. ot echad meesrin uteren atvavn deorayyta yahav aleh laagana aleh. amar rabbi yehuda may dichtiv vayhi bihyotam bassade. may bassade. da itteta. veal da kam uketil leh. deha missitra da yarit lekatla missitra disml degarim mota lechol alma. vekanne kayin lehevel al nukeveh. rabbi chiyyay amar ha chazinan dichtiv vayyichar lekayin meod vayyippelu fanav al dela itkabbil karbaneh. amar leh hachi hu vecholla hava lakavleh.

Veamar rabbi yehuda may dichtiv halo im tetiv seet veim lo tetiv lappetach chattat rovetz. ella hachi kaamar halo im tetiv ovadach seet. may seet. kedichtiv (Bereshit 49:3) yeter seet deha buchera shevacha it leh becholla taddir. vetalyay beovadohi. veal da im tetiv seet. veim lo tetiv lappetach chattat rovetz.
72: Dilela deminneh nafkin dinin al ovadin bishin dealma. petach kema deat amer (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. ulehahu petach, chattat rovetz da malach hammavet. vehu zammin leitperaa minach.

Ta chaze, berosh hashshana ityelid adam. berosh hashshana vadday raza leela vetatta. rosh hashshana leela. rosh hashshana letatta. (sof ki tetze) berosh hashshana akarot nifkadot. menalan divrosh hashshana hava. dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:1) vaAdonai pakad et sara vaAdonai dayyka da rosh hashshana. uvegin denafik adam merosh hashshana (davar acher venafik) nafik bedina vealma kayyma bedina. uvegine kach lappetach vadday. chattat rovetz begin leitperaa minach. veelecha teshukato ad detishtetze.

Veatta timshol bo. raza hu dichtiv, (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam. mikkan amru la shallit kudesha berich hu ella bezimna deyishtetzun chayyayve alma. veal da kevan demalach hammavet yeshetze lon. keden kudesha berich hu shallit aloy dela yippuk leavasha alma dichtiv veatta timshal bo (betiyyuveta) veatta dayyka.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bekutera defalga kafsira (kasetayraa) shechiach. rabbi yehuda amar veatta timshal bo bityuveta.

Rabbi yose amar kad havu innun darin dekayin azlin bealma havu metarteshe ara vehavu damyayn leillae vetattae. amar rabbi yitzchak aza vaazael kad naflu meatar kedushatayyhu milleela, chamu benat bene nesha vechatu veolidu benin, veillen havu nefilim dichtiv hannefilim hayu baaretz.

Rabbi chiyyay amar benoy dekayin havu bene elohim. deha kad ata 131 al chavva atil bah zuhama veitabberat veolidat lekayin. vechezu dileh la havat dame lishar beni nesha. vechol innun deatyayn missitra dileh la havu ikrun ella beni haelohim.

Rabbi yehuda amar veafillu innun (bene) nefilim hachi ikrun. hemma haggibborim. shittin hava beara kechusheban dilela. ketiv hacha hema haggibborim asher meolam uchetiv hatam (Shir HaShirim 3:7) shishshim gibborim saviv lah. rabbi yose omer hema haggibborim asher meolam mammash. meolam dayyka. anshe hashshem, may shem da hu olam dekaamaran. anshe hashshem dayyka. ketiv hacha anshe hashshem uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 24) benakvo shem, uchetiv, (Vayikra 24:11) vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem.

Rabbi chiyyay amar meolam mammash havu. umeolam diltatta natal lon kudesha berich hu kema deat amer (da havo veguverin gaberan desitra bisha havo dichtiv anshe sham anshe hashshem lo ketiv ella anshe sham kegavvna da ketiv) (Tehillim 25:6) zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meolam hemma. meolam vadday. umeolam diltatta natil lon kudesha berich hu. veinnun avahan kadmae lemeheve reticha kaddisha leela. uf hacha hemma haggibborim asher meolam. meolam vadday natil lon kudesha berich hu. rabbi yitzchak amar meolam (umay hu) da mittato shellishlomo dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) shishshim gibborim saviv lah. rabbi acha amar kulhu bene haelohim ikrun (davar acher 33 deha ad lo atebasemat). (chaser kan ayyen sof hassefer):

Tosefta amru rabbotteno zichrono livracha beshaotta devara kudesha bericha hu leadam bera leh beginta deeden vtztziuhu al sheva mitztzevott. chav vittegrash migginta deeden. uttere malache shemaya azza vaazael amru kamme kudesha bericha hu, illu havina anan beara havina zakkain. amar lehu kudesha bericha hu, vchi attun yachlin al yitztzera bisha, amru kammeh yachlin. miyyad appil lon kudesha bericha hu kema deat amer hannepilim hayu baaretz uchetiv haggibborim vegomer. uveshaatta denachattu leara al behu yitztzera visha shenneemar vyyikchu lahem nashim mikkol asher bacharu, chavu vitteakaru mikdushattayyhu, (74 kan hattosefta)
Ta chaze, kulhon netian havu setimin reshimin dakkikin beatra chad. levatar akaran kudesha berich hu veashtil lon beatar ochora veitkayyaymu.

Rabbi yesa shaal may dichtiv ze sefer toldot adam beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim asa otam zachar unekeva beraam vayvarech otam. amar leh rabbi abba raza illaa hu. taninan telat sifrin petichan berosh hashana chad detzaddikim gemurim
73: Vechulei sefer illaa deha minneh nafak kolla. nafik minneh ketiva. sefer emtzaita kelala deela vetatta (sefer acher sefer deihu kelala dilella vetatta veachid lechol sitrin raza vakev) (kefi ze hattikkun nimtza bishne sifre hayyad) (veachid lechol sitrin raza deadam kadmaa, sefer telitaa deikre 2 tora) detora shebbichtav adam kadmaa. sefer (sefer acher telitaa) deikre toldot adam veda ihu detzaddikim gemurim. hada hu dichtiv ze sefer toldot adam da tzaddik vadday deavid toldot. beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim. deha vadday keden ittakkan kola leela vetatta veitkayyaymu bedugema chada. zachar unekeva beraam setam chad itkelil bechad.

Matnitin (davar acher vakev) ketiv, (Mishlei 18:10) migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav. da hu sefer toldot adam derahit behahu miggedal (96 2). hay migdal may avidteh. ella da hu migdal david. veda hu migdal oz shem Adonai. vecholla chad. hacha yedia livne mehemnuta da hu vday sefer toldot. (it dela garse) (adam livne mehemanuta sodo migdal oz sham Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav Adonai tzaddik) (adam livne mehemanuta).

Veamar rabbi abba (lekamman noah 2) sefer vday (nachtu) (nachit) leh leadam harishon. uveh hava yada chachmeta illaa. vesifra da mata livni elahin chakkime dara. uman dezache leashgacha beh yada beh chachma illaa. umashgichin beh veyadin beh. vesifra da nachit leh mare derazin. utelat shelichan memannan kammeh.

Uveshaata denafak adam migginta deeden achid behahu sifra. kad nafik (minneh) tas minneh (letara) tzalle uvache kamme mareh veativu leh kemillekaddemin. begin dela titneshe chachmeta mibbeni nesha veyishtaddelun leminda lemarehon.

Vechen taninan sefer hava leh lechanoch. veda sefer meatar desifra detoldot adam hava. veda hu raza dechachmeta. deha meara itnetil hada hu dichtiv veenennu ki lakach oto elohim. vehu hannaar. kedichtiv, (Mishlei 22:6) chanoch lannaar al pi darko.

Vechol ginze illae itmasran bideh. veda mesir veyahiv veavid shelichuta. veelef (lekamman 56) maftechan itmasran bideh. umea birchan natil bechol yoma vekashir keshirin lemareh. mealma natil leh kudesha berich hu leshimmusheh hada hu dichtiv ki lakach oto elohim.

Umin da itmasar sifra deikre sifra dechanoch. beshaata daachid leh kudesha berich hu achame leh kol ginze illae. achame leh ilana dechayye bego metziut ginta vetarpoy veanpoy. vechola chamenan besifreh. zakkain innun chaside illain dechachmeta illaa itgeli lehu vela itneshe minnayyhu lealmin kema deat amer, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam:

Vayyomer Adonai lo yadon ruchi baadam leolam beshaggam hu basar vegomer. (chaser) rabbi acha amar behahu zimna hava hahu nahara denagid venafik, appik rucha ilaa meilana dechayye vaarik beilana (desharyay beh mota) (meilana demota) veitmashshechan ruchin begavavyyhu divne nesha yomin (zimnin) saggiin. ad desalku bishin veitattedu lappetach. keden istallak rucha illaa mehahu ilana beshaata difrach nishmetin bivne (mibbene) nesha hada hu dichtiv lo yadon ruchi baadam leolam. lemehav leolam beshaata defarchu nishmetin bivne nesha.

Beshaggam hu basar rabbi elazar amar (deve rabbi elazar amma) (lekamman 98 amud alef) beshaggam da moshe. deihu nahir lesihara. umechela da kayyaymin bene nesha bealma yomin (zimnin) saggiin. vehayu yamav mea veesrim shana, ramaz lemoshe deal yedeh tora ityehivat. ucheden yarik (sefer acher zarik) chayyin livne nasha mehahu ilana dechayyin. vechach hava. ilmale dechavu yisrael hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot, cherut mimmalach hammavet. deha ilana dechayye hava mashich letatta.
Veal da beshaggam deihu basar kayyayma milla laaraka (leitrachaka) rucha dechayye. beshaggam achid letatta achid leela. veal da taninan moshe la mit ella itkenish
74: Mealma vehava nahir lesihara. deha shimsha af al gav deitkenash mealma la mit ella al veanhir lesihara. kach moshe.
Davar acher beshaggam hu basar bimshichu derucha bivne nesha zimna rabba ithaddar lemeheve basar leitmashcha batar gufa uleishtadala beovadin dehay alma.

Amar rabbi yitzchak kol (lekamman noah 2 darin deishtachlalu mishshet kullehu tzaddike vachaside. levatar atepashetav veolidu vaavaleypev umanuta 0) dealma leshatzaa berumechin usayyfin. ad deata noach veatkin lon tikkuna dealma ulemiflach uleatkana ara. deha bekadmita la havu zarin vechatzdin. levatar itzterichu lehay dichtiv od kol yeme haaretz vegomer.

Rabbi elazar amar zamin kudesha berich hu letakkana alma uleatkana rucha bivne nesha begin deyorchun yomin lealmin hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 65:22) ki kime haetz yeme ammi vegomer uchetiv, (sham 25) villa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz ki Adonai dibber: ad kan ishtachlalu milin mikkan ulehala tikuna defarshata: bereshit

Amar rabbi shimon, ha taninan dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma galif begilufe deraza dimhemnuta go tehirin berazin illain. vegalif leela vegalif letatta vecholla beraza chada. veavid alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa. veda kaim lokovel da. lemehve kolla chad beyichuda chada. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu galif gelife deatvavn ela vetatta. uvehu bera almin.

Veta chaze, kegavvna deavad kudesha berich hu alma hachi name bera leh leadam kadmaa. patach veamar, (Hoshea 6:7) vehemma keadam avru berit vegomer. deha kudesha berich hu aatar leh beitterin illain. uvera leh beshit sitrin dealma. lemehve shelim becholla. vecholla zaan vedachalan mikkameh. deha kad itbere adam itbere bediukena illaa. vehavu mistakkelan behahu diukena vezaan vedachalan mikkammeh. ulevatar ail leh kudesha berich hu beginta deeden leitaddena tamman beiddunin ilain. vehavu malachin illain sacharin leh umeshammeshin kammeh. verazin demarehon havu odin leh.
Ta chaze, beshaata deail leh kudesha berich hu leginta deeden, hava chame veistakkal mittamman kol razin illain vechol chachmeta. begin leminda uleistakkala bikara demareh.

Shiva hechalin medorin innun leela deinnun raza dimhemnuta illaa. veshiva hechalin innun letatta (kegavvna dilhon chad lokovel chad. shiva madorin dehechalin innun letatta) kegavvna dilela. veinnun shit kegavvna illaa vechad tamir veganiz ihu leela. vechol illen innun beraza illaa. begin dechol hani hechalin it behu kegavvna dilela. veit behu kegavvna diltatta. lemeheve kalil bediukena deraza dilela uvidiukena deraza diltatta, uvehu hava diyyureh deadam.

Ulevatar deittarach migginta deeden atkin lon kudesha berich hu lenishmathon detzaddikaya leishtashea behu kedka chaze mizziva dikara illaa. vechol chad vechad ittakkan kegavvna dilela uchegavvna diltatta kema deokimna.

Hekkala kadmaa. atar deihu mittakkan letatta lemehve kegavvna dilela. veha itaru chavrayay nimmuse deginta deeden kema deihu beraza illaa (deihu metakken lego, go temira deraza diltatta ganiz vesatim mikkol) (nusach acher veihu mittakken lego vesatim mikkola) vela shalta beh ena. bar nishmathon detzaddikayay. lemehevi
75: Gelifan leela vetatta. uleistakkala mittamman beraza demarehon uveinnuga dilela.

Veillen innun tzaddikaya dela achlefu yekara demarehon begin dachala ochora. ketiv, (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret baalah, raza dimhemnuta leitdabbeka bar nash bemareh uledachala minneh tadir vela yiste leyamina usemala. veha okimna dela yehach bar nash batar dachala ochora deikre eshet zenunim. uvegin kach ketiv, (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meishsha zara minnachriyya amareha hecholika.

Hechala da kaim bediukena deraza illaa. begin dechad nishmatin detzaddikaya nafke mehay alma, alin go illen hechalin di beginta deeden diltatta. vetamman (alin) yatvin kol chad vechad kol hahu zimna deitztericha nishmata lemetav tamman.

Uvechol hechala vehechala it diukenin kegavvna (illaa) dilela udeyoknin kegavvna (tattaa) diltatta. vetamman itlabbeshat nishmata bilvushin kegavvna dehay alma. veitadnat tamman kol hahu zimna deitzterichat ad demate zimna lesalka leatar illaa kema deitzterich. umiggo hahu mana deitlabbeshat beh chamat diukenin illain leistakkala bikara demarehon.

Behay hechala it nehorin illain leistakkala. benishmathon deinnun giyyorin deitgayyru kayymin tamman vealin tamman leistakkala bikara illaa umitlabbeshan tamman bilvusha chada dinhora denahir vela nahir. vehahu hechala makfa meeven tava vedahava.

Vetamman ihu pitcha chada denachit lokovel pitcha degehinnom. mittamman mistakkelan bechol innun chayyayve (deyisrael) (nusach acher deovde avoda zara) dela alu bivrit kayyayma kaddisha veitterachu beinnun malache chabbala detarde lon benura dedalik. veinnun chaman vechadan al deitgayyru.

Utelat zimnin beyoma naharin miggo nehiru illaa umishtashean tamman. veela minnehon ovadya veunkelos giyyora ushear giorin deitgayyru. kegavvna da leela kad zachan lesalleka nishmathon leitattera tamman:

Hechala tinyayna. hechala da kayyma lego mehay hechala kadmaa, vehay (pitcha ihu samich lego mearta) (nusach acher hechala samich limarta) deavahan. vehay hechala nahir mikkadmaa. hacha it kol avanin yakkirin demakfan leh.

Bego dehay hechala, it nehiru chad kalil mikkol gevavnin veihu nahir meela letatta. behay hechala kayyaymin (kol) innun desavlu yissurin umarin behay alma begin leittakkena. vehavu modan umeshabbechan lemarehon kol yoma. vela havu mevattelin tzelotayyhu lealmin.

Lego mehay hechala kayyaymin kol innun dimkaddeshin (bechol yoma) bechol chela shema demarehon veativu amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach bechol chela. veillen innun kayyaymin lego bego hay hechala. vehahu nehora dechalil kol gevavnin nahir lon. mehahu nehiru kayyaymin vechaman nehorin ochoranin deitachadan vela itachadan begavvavyyhu. veela minnehon mashiach deihu al vekaim benayyhu venachit lon.

Ihu natil mehay hechala veal behechala telitaa vetamman chol innun bene marin ucheevin yattir vechol innun dardeke deve rabban dela ashlimu yomin. vechol innun deatzevin al charuv be makdesha (veoshidu) vehavu oshdin dimin. kulhon kayyaymin behahu hechala, veihu menachem lon.
Venatil mehay hechala veal behechala reviaa, vetamman kol innun avele tziyyon viyrushala 40 vechol innun katole dishar amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veihu share uvache.
76: Ucheden kol innun nesiin dezara dedavid kulhu achidan beh umenachamin leh.

Share tinyaynut uvache ad dekala nafik umitached behahu kala vesalik leela veishtahe tamman ad resh yarcha. vechad nachit nachatayn immeh kamma nehorin vezivin menaharin lechol innun hechalin veasvavta unehora lechol innun katolin uveni marin umachovin disvilu immeh demashiach.

Ucheden purepira lavish. vetamman chakikin ureshimin kol innun katole dishar amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot behahu purepira. vesalik hahu purepira leela veitchakkak tamman go purepira illaa demalka. vekudesha berich hu zammin lealbasha hahu purepira ulemedan ammin dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:6) yadin baggoyim male geviyyot. ad di ata venachim lon venachatin immeh (kema) nehorin veiddunin leitaddena vechamma malachin uretichin immeh. kol chad vechad bemalbusha (nusach acher uvida dechol chad vechad malbusha) leitlabbesha behu kol innun nishmatin dekatolin vetamman mitaddenin kol hahu zimna deihu salik venachit.

Lego mehay hechala kayyme go darga illaa innun asara ravrevin memannan (kegon) rabbi akiva vechavroy. vechulhu salke bisliku. go aspaklaryaa dilela, venaharin beziv yekara illaa. alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo:

Behechala chamishaa kayyaymin kol innun marehon dityuveta shelemta detavu mechataehon veitnachamu behu venafkat nishmatayyhu bedachyu (vechol innun marehon detiuveta) vechol innun dekaddishu shema demarehon vekabbilu alayyhu mota. uvetara dehay hechala (pitcha) kaim menashshe melech yehuda dekabbil leh kudesha berich hu bityuveta shelemta vechatar leh chatira lekabbela leh.

Ulego mehay hechala kayyaymin kol innun marehon dityuveta takkifa. denishmathon nafkat beshaata deitmarmeru al ovadehon. veillen mitaddenin beidduna illaa bechol yoma veyoma. utelat zimnin beyoma nehiru al behahu hechala demitaddenin beh kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh. vechol chad nichva minhiru dechuppa dechavreh ben letatta ben leela.

Hay hechala kayyma al innun hechle tattae. veafillu tzaddikim gemurin la yachlin leaalaa bego (hahu) hay hechala ulemekam beh. vehay ihu darga illaa al kolla (beh) bar darga dechaside deihu darga illaa al kolla:

Hechala shetitaa hechala da hechala dechaside. hechala da hechala illaa al kolla. vehay hu hechala dekayyma al kolla. hechala deyamina let man deyakim beh. ella innun chasidim kaddishin vechol innun dimrachame lemarehon birchimu sagge. ulefitcha dehay hechala kayyma kol innun dimyachade yichuda demarehon bechol yoma. veillen alin behay hechala uzeminin lesalleka bekadmita.

Veela mehay pitcha avraham yamina dekudesha berich hu. ulefitcha ochora kayyma yitzchak deitakkad al gabbe madbecha vehava karbana shelim kammeh dekudesha berich hu. ulefitcha ochora lego kayyma yaakov shelema uteresar shevatin sacharaneh ushechinta al reshayyhu.

Vechad yisrael beaku itaru telat abbahan umitare lah lishchinta leaggana alayyhu. ucheden ihi salka veitattera leela veaggana alayyhu deyisrael. uchema deit hechalin letatta beginta deeden, hachi name leela it hechalin metakkenan deinnun raza dimhemanuta. vechol (innun) hani hechalin kulhu mitkashsheran umitatteran bechad hechala deihu
Hechala sheviaa vehay hechala ihu ganiz vesatim mikkol shear hechalin. beemtzaita dehay hechala kaim chad ammuda
77: Deihu bigvavnin saggiin yarok chivvavr sumak ucham. vechad nishmatin salkin innun alin go hay hechala. man deitchazze lehay gavvavn salik beh. uman deitchazze lehay gavavn salik beh. kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh.
Veillen shit hechalin innun lemadora kidamaran. usheviaa lav ihu lemadora. veshit kolla beraza deshet. veal da ketiv bara shit. shit dargin leela shit dargin letatta vecholla raza chada.

Ta chaze, bereshit. rabbi yehuda amar teren battin havu, bayit rishon uvayit sheni. da illaa veda tattaa. teren hehin innun, da illaa veda tattaa vechulhu chad. 2 illaa patcha tarin lechol sitra. dehachi hu dechalil da beda. rishit. keden hu reshit leoola bechushebna devinyana. rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi elazar bereshit da kelala diukena (davar acher dediyyukena) dechol diukenin kelilan beh. da raza dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:28) hu mare demut kevod Adonai, chezu deitchazzun beh shit ochoranin. veda hu bereshit bara shit.

Ta chaze, kad alin vehay chezu shit gevavnin, hi atkinat garma leachazaa lon ulemifal behu umanuta dealma. vei tema dehay umanuta dealma middarga da hu. ketiv bara shit. shevacha deshit ihu deavde umanuta behay.

Rabbi yose patach (Shir HaShirim 2:12) hannitztzanim niru vaaretz et hazzamir higgia vekol hattor nishma beartzenu. hannitztzanim (niru beeretz) da hu raza deshit dargin (gillayon 507) alah veihi sheviaa. veilen innun shitt dargin darga deavraham vedarga deyitzchak vedarga deyaakov veyachin uvoaz veyosef kulhu itchazu veara dichtiv niru vaaretz. baaretz da hi karta kaddisha deeretz yisrael). niru vaaretz, begin deinnun diukenin leitchazzaa behay darga. et hazzamir higgia, deha keden meshabbach umehaddar kema deat amer (Tehillim 30:13) lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom. uvegin kach ikre mizmor kema ditninan dichtiv mizmor ledavid desharet aleh shechinta beresha. veda hu et hazzamir higgia. rabbi chiyyay amar deha keden mata zimna leshabbecha.

Rabbi abba amar alma illaa satim vechol milloy setimin. begin dekayyma beraza illaa yoma dechol yomin (ruma dechol ravemayn). vechad bara veappik, appik ilen shit. uvegin deihu satim dechol milloy setimin, amar bereshit bara shit yomin illain. vela amar man bara lehon. begin deihu alma ilaa setima.

Ulevatar gale veamar lan avidta tattaa. veamar man bera leh, begin deihu alma dekayyma beitgalleyay. veamar bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. vela ketiv bara satim (davar acher beorach satim) bara et hashshamayim. begin deihu alma beitgalleya veamar bara elohim, elohim vadday shema beitgalleya. kadmaa bistima deihu illaa. tattaa beitgalleya. lemeheve tadir ovada dekudesha berich hu satim vegalleya. veraza dishma kaddisha hachi hu satim vegalleya.
Et hashshamayim leasgaa shamayim tattae letatta. veet haaretz leachlala ertz diltatta. uleasgaa (la) kol ovadaha kegavvna dilela:

Vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu kidkaamaran. vehaaretz da eretz illaa delet lah nehora miggarmah. hayta. bekadmita kevar havat kedka yeut. vehasheta tohu vavohu vechoshech. hayta dayyka. levatar azirat garmah veazirat nehora. tohu vavohu vechoshech veruach arba yesode alma deishtachlelu bah.

Davar acher veet haaretz kidkaamaran leasgaa ara diltatta deihi itavidat bechamma medorin (nehorin) kolla kegavvna illaa. veda hu vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech veruach. ilen innun medore ara. eretz. adama. gi. neshiyya. tziya. arka. tevel. vegadol shebbechulam tevel dichtiv, (Tehillim 9:9) vehu
78: Amar rabbi yose man hu tziyya. amar leh da hu atar degehinnom kema deat amer tziyya vetzalmavet. veraza da ketiv, (davar acher dichtiv) (bamelat) vechoshech al pene tehom. da raza atar degehinnom. da hu tziyya atar demalach hammavet kidkaamaran deihu machshich anpayyhu divriyyayta. veda hu atar dechoshech illaa.

Tohu da neshiyya dela itchazyay bah chezu kelal ad deitneshe mikkolla. veal da itkere neshiyya. vavohu da arka atar dela itneshe. rabbi chiyyay amar da ge. veruach elohim merachefet da lokovel tevel deittezan meruach elohim, vecholla kechad hu.

Kegavvna da it leeretz illaa. shiva medorin innun leela darga al darga uvechulho medorin malache illae illen al illen. hachi name letatta. vecholla achid da beda lemeheve kolla chad. shiva medorin innun leela. veha eretz illaa achidat lon vechulhu kayymin vah. uvechulhon kayyma tushebachta dekudesha berich hu. dargin perishan da min da. veatrin perishan da min da:

Madora kadmaa letatta hu atar be chashuch dela nahir. vehu mittakkan lemadore ruche vekastire veilule takkifin dela itchazyayn. vela it beh nehora vela chashocha vela diukena kelal. vetamman la yadin beh yedia kelal delav beh tzura go kelal kuresyay (saveratea).

Veal hahu atar memanna chad malacha tahariel shemeh. veimmeh shivin memannan meoffin. veitmachun mazzike shevivin (dealayyhu) vela kayyaymin vela itchazzun vela mishtakkeche. vechad ate tzafra kullehu (19 1) mitchaddeshan vela kayyme. kad matan legabbe hahu (dehay) atar avdin vela mishtakkechin vealin bechad nukeva dithoma vela itchazzun. kad itremish lelya itmachun meinnun shevivin ad demate tzafra:

Madora tinyayna hu atar denahir yattir veihu chashuch. aval la chashuch kehahu kadmaa. vehu mittakkan lemadore malachin illain di memannan al ovadehon divni nesha ulemiste (davar acher lemiste) lehon behahu orach bisha deinnun azlin. vehahu atar itchazze yattir min kadmaa. veillen malachin it lehon kerava (kureva) im bene nasha umitzenan (vametahenan) merecha uvusema diltatta lesalka betoalta uleanhara yattir.

Vealayyhu chad memanna kedumiel shemeh. veillen patchin shirata umishtakkeche veazlin lon. vela itchazzun ad deyisrael letatta patche veamre shirata. keden kayyman beduchetayyhu veitchazzan nehirin yattir. telat zimnin beyoma mekaddeshe kedusheta. vechad yisrael aske beorayyta kulhon tasin vesahade (innun) sahaduta leela. vekudesha berich hu chayyis alayyhu:

Madora telitaa hu atar dishvivin vekittorin. vetamman negidu dinhar dinur denagid venafik deihu be mokda denafshayyhu derashshiayya. demittamman nachit esha al rishayyhu derashshiayyay, vetamman malache chabbala detarde lehu.

Vetamman ishtakkach daletoryay alayyhu deyisrael lezimnin uleastaa lon. bar bezimna denasve asvavta ledachyay leh. vechad memanna alayyhu missitra dismala kulhu missitra dechoshech kema deat amer vechoshech al pene tehom. vasemaal chayyayva ishtechach tamman:
Madora reviaa hu atar denahir. vetamman hu nehiru lemalache illae di vistar yamina. ufetachu shirata vesayyeyme vela azlin leaavara kahane kadmae
79: Defatchin shirata umittokdan umitavran benur dalik vetavin umitchaddeshin kemilkadmin. vehane kayymin beduchetayyhu vela mitavran. vehani malache derachame dela meshanyayn lealmin.

Vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot vegomer veillen avdin shelichutayyhu bealma vela itchazzun livne nasha bar bechezvav o besitra ochora (34 1) besuchletanu sagge. vechad malacha memanna alayyhu pdl shemeh. uveh petichin maftechan derachame leinnun detayyvin legabbeh demarehon. ufatchin tarin leaavara tzelothon uvautehon:

Madora chamishaa hu madora denahir binhiru yattir mikkulhu kadmae. veit beh malachin minhon esha uminhon mayya. lezimnin ishtechachu berachame ulezimnin ishtechachu bedina. illen besitra da veillen besitra da. lezimnin naharin illen vechashchin illen. veillen memannan lezammera lemarehon. illen befalgut lelya. veillen kad salik nehora. vechad memanna alayyhu kadshiel shemeh.

Kad itpelag lelya veitar ruach tzafon vekudesha berich hu ate (60 amud bet) leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden. keden ruach tzafon akkish umata leinnun dimmannan befalgut lelya lezammera. vechulhu mezammerin ufatchin shirata. vechad ate tzafra umitchabber kadruta detzafra binhora. keden kulhu ochoranin amrin shirata. vechol kochve rekia vechol shear malachin (diltatta) mesayyin lon kema dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol beni elohim. ad deyisrael natle shirata vetushebachta abbatrayyhu:

Madora shetitaa hu madora illaa kariv lemalchu shemaya. uveh arvin venaharin venachalin demitpallegin min yamma vechamma nunin innun dimrachashan learba sitre alma. veela minhon sarchin memannan. vechad memanna alayyhu veoriel shemeh. vehu memanna al kol illen tattain.

Vechulhu natle beshaate verige kad natle arve lesitra da ulesitra da. kad natle arve listar (darom) mizrach memanna dekayyma alayyhu lehahu sitra hu mikkael deata mimina. vechad natle arve listar tzafon memanna dekayyma alayyhu lehahu sitra hu gavriel deate missitra dismala. vechad natle arve listar (mizrach) darom ha tamman ihu memanna dekayyma alayyhu lehahu sitra refael (nusach acher uriel) shemeh vehu limina. vechad natle arve listar maarav memanna dekayyma alayyhu lehahu sitra hu oriel (nusach acher refael) veihu levatraa:

Madora sheviaa hu madora illaa al kolla. vetamman la ishtakkachu bar nishmathon detzaddikayay detamman mitaddenin behahu zihara illaa. umitaddenin beiddunin vetafnukin (illaa) illain. vetamman la ishtakkachu bar innun zakkain. veginze shalom uveracha unedava. kolla hu kegavvna illaa veha amru chavrayay.

Keden hu laaretz diltatta beshiva madorin. vechulhu kegavvna dilela. uvechulho it zinin kechezu bene nesha. vechulhu modan umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu. velet man deyada yekareh keinnun deinnun bemadora illaa. veillen chazan yekareh kedka yeut lemiflach leh uleshabbecha leh uleishtemoda yekareh.
Vealma da illaa deihu tevel la kayyma bekiyyumeh ella beginehon detzaddikayyay deinnun gufin kaddishin.
